Watchlist all case (and talk) pages: [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}&action=watch '''Front'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Evidence&action=watch '''Ev.'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Workshop&action=watch '''Wshp.'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Proposed_decision&action=watch '''PD.''']
Once the case is closed, editors should edit the [[#Enforcement log]] as needed, but the other content of this page may not be edited except by clerks or arbitrators. Please raise any questions about this decision at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Clarification and Amendment]], any general questions at [[Wikipedia talk:Arbitration Committee]], and report violations of the remedies passed in the decision to [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement]]. == Case information == === Involved parties === *{{userlinks|Robert McClenon}}, ''filing party'' *{{userlinks|Eric Corbett}} *{{userlinks|Two kinds of pork}} *{{userlinks|SPECIFICO}} *{{userlinks|Carolmooredc}} *{{userlinks|Neotarf}} *{{userlinks|Sitush}} (added on October 21 by [[User:Penwhale]] per [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Gender_Gap_Task_Force/Evidence&diff=630499697&oldid=630499218 this]) ===Prior dispute resolution=== *[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Incidents&diff=prev&oldid=624112438] *[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia%3AAdministrators%27_noticeboard%2FIncidents&diff=624433683&oldid=624432719] Closed version of ANI thread: *[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia%3AAdministrators%27_noticeboard%2FIncidents&diff=624420359&oldid=624419734#Disruption_of_Wikiproject] == Preliminary statements == ===Statement by Robert McClenon=== Recent reports of disruption of the Gender Gap Task Force, [[Wikipedia talk:WikiProject Countering systemic bias/Gender gap task force]], were taken to [[WP:ANI]] and were closed inconclusively. The suggestion was made that the issue of disruption of the GGTF should be addressed by the ArbCom. The founder of Wikipedia concurred: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk%3AJimbo_Wales&diff=624271238&oldid=624271124 The Arbitration Committee is asked to open a case to consider user conduct issues at the GGTF. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 16:20, 8 September 2014 (UTC) :The Wikiproject on countering systemic bias, and the Gender Gap Task Force, are ongoing activities for the improvement of Wikipedia. The Gender Gap Task Force (GGTF) is being disrupted by disparaging comments by two editors (EC and TKOP) who are not participants in the task force who question the need to address the gender gap, and by hostility by one participant in the task force (SPECIFICO) to another participant in the task force (CM). The ANI was closed inconclusively. A full evidentiary case is needed to identify the issues more fully. It is requested that the ArbCom consider whether topic bans for disruptive editing or interaction bans are necessary. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 21:44, 8 September 2014 (UTC) Since the task force has not been disrupted since the ANI thread was closed inconclusively, I am willing to withdraw this filing ''without prejudice'' and refile it in the future if the disruption resumes. (I am not optimistic, but I am willing to wait and see.) [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 23:03, 9 September 2014 (UTC) First, the climate at [[WP:ANI]] is toxic. The hostility at GGTF hasn't really cleared, only gone to WP:ANI. Second, I will note that Sitush wrote, at WP:ANI: "We've got the wrong target here and her [Carol Moore's\ behaviour will be going to ArbCom, IBAN or no IBAN." Since Sitush doesn't control whether a case goes to ArbCom, I assume that he means that her behavior ''should'' be going to ArbCom. I would suggest that he be added to the case as a party. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 15:59, 17 September 2014 (UTC) :[[User:Sitush]]: I wasn't suggesting that you be added as a party because of your conduct at GGTF, but because of your blustering against Carol Moore at WP:ANI. You apparently are implying that she needs to be taken to ArbCom. If you would prefer to file a separate case against her, you can, but a case against an editor is usually (not always) preceded by a [[WP:RFC/U|User Conduct Request for Comments]]. [[User:Robert McClenon|Robert McClenon]] ([[User talk:Robert McClenon|talk]]) 16:38, 17 September 2014 (UTC) === Statement by Eric Corbett === I can only assume, given ArbCom's predisposition to blame everyone and apportion blame across the board without bothering to look at the evidence, that this is a form of [[seppuku]] on Robert's part. [[User:Eric Corbett| Eric]] [[User talk:Eric Corbett|Corbett]] 02:39, 9 September 2014 (UTC) === Statement by Two kinds of pork === This request is premature and should be declined. There are problems, however these problems can be resolved if everyone examines their own behavior and makes some adjustments. Yes, there have been unwarranted accusations on the group talk page. Yes there is some incivility. I think all parties should bend over backwards to AGF. Don't assume someone has an agenda (other than wanting to close the GG). Don't make ad-hominem arguments. Don't try to look for a personal attack in every sentence, as it only fosters ill will. The arbitration guide says this is not to be a debate, so I won't address some points raised by some others that I naturally disagree with. I suggest an examination of the talk archives would give the arbitrators an unadulterated version on the background of this filing. One of the problems that this project has is some of the participants seem to believe that the project should be owned by, run by, and for women only. No one believes (or should) that any project should be owned or run by one set of editors with specific traits. This project is not just supposed to benefit women, because closing the gender gap benefits ''everyone''. Example 1: {{user|Neotarf}} asked for clarification about whether a video could be used as a RS, I suggested they check RSN and the response was {{tq|Why don't you present it to them yourself if you think they may be interested. I posted it here as an FYI for consideration '''by the women''', in the context of '''their''' project.}} [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Countering_systemic_bias/Gender_gap_task_force&diff=623429776&oldid=623398856] Example 2: Neotarf again makes ad-hominem attacks and continues to assert the project is owned by gender. {{tq|That Cla68 is concerned about misogyny I find surprising--from the comments he has made off wiki I would have guessed the opposite. Likewise with the individuals '''who were previously interested in editing pornography articles''' and who are now engaging with the Gender Gap project--I can't seem to follow why they are unarchiving threads that were previously archived '''by the women''' as off-topic or disruptive.}}[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=625045811&oldid=625038415] Could you imagine the hue raised if someone on another project made similar comments but replaced "by the women" with "by the white Protestants?" I'm willing to cut Neotarf a little slack because I recognize there ''is'' a gender gap, but the small minority that are claiming feminine ownership and making ad-hominem attacks are digging in their heels and show no signs of relenting. === Statement by SPECIFICO === I had no comment when this request was initially opened. Events since that time have made it clear that the community and nearly a dozen Admins have not been able to address things in a rational, orderly, or equitable manner. The credibility of fundamental WP processes is at stake. I now urge Arbcom to hear this case, possibly with revised or expanded definition as to its scope and involved parties. [[User:SPECIFICO | '''SPECIFICO''']][[User_talk:SPECIFICO | ''talk'']] 00:45, 17 September 2014 (UTC) :Forum shopping, canvassing, and meat puppetry appear to have polluted community processes and exacerbated tensions among editors. [[User:SPECIFICO | '''SPECIFICO''']][[User_talk:SPECIFICO | ''talk'']] 13:52, 24 September 2014 (UTC) === Statement by Carolmooredc === #I think this request is premature since the three parties who have been [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive853#Disruption_of_Wikiproject|criticized as disruptive]] have not even been given a chance to prove they can work collaboratively. So I believe this request should be closed by the nominator. #Note that everything they've complained about has been individual opinions ignored too long on the main page, discussion points, poorly formed proposals, odd ball comments and annoyed reactions to their constant criticism and nitpicking. About the only thing accomplished since the project became more active again in early July is creation of a [[User:Carolmooredc/My_Sandbox_1|Draft Gender Gap Task Force Resources page]], much of it from links posted at the [http://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Gender_gap#Discuss Wikimedia Foundation-sponsored Gender Gap email list]. Because of the disruption it has been impossible to discuss in a serious and collaborative fashion what we think the scope, goals and projects of the task force should be. However, one would like to think that editors would take the advice of the ANI closer. #I should ''not'' be the only complainant mentioned because these individuals will single me out as ''the real problem'' as they have done in this issue and as one has in the past. A number of other individuals also have been supportive of the project and expressed some or a great deal of dismay at the process on the talk page; half of them commented at the [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive853#Disruption_of_Wikiproject|WP:ANI]]. They too should be listed: [[User:Anne Delong]], [[User:BoboMeowCat]], [[User:Elaqueate]], [[User:EvergreenFir]], [[User:Rich Farmbrough]], [[User:Knowledgekid87]], [[User:Lightbreather]], [[User:Montanabw]], [[User:Neotarf]], [[User:LawrencePrincipe]], [[User:SlimVirgin]], [[User:Thebrycepeake]]. Other individuals tangetially involved in the project have had useful ideas and critiques; some explicit supporters of the most critical individuals also have commented. '''[[User:Carolmooredc|Carolmooredc]] ([[User talk:Carolmooredc|Talkie-Talkie]])''' 21:50, 8 September 2014 (UTC) :::@[[User:Rschen7754]] and @[[User:The Devil's Advocate]]. First I believe I cannot talk about the past proceeding you mention. However, I believe I can say that as I have evidenced [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/IncidentArchive853#User:SPECIFICO|in the SPECIFICO section]] of the Disruption of a Wikiproject ANI, I have been under unrelenting Wikihounding from SPECIFICO for more than a year. See especially the [https://tools.wmflabs.org/sigma/editorinteract.py?user1=Carolmooredc&user2=SPECIFICO&user3=&startdate=20140401&enddate=20140903&ns=&allusers=on April 1-September 3, 2014 Interaction Analyzers Results]. Staying away from certain articles and ignoring his following me to to articles he's never edited before hasn't stopped it. Failing to respond at all often was difficult once his Wikihounding started at the Gender Gap task force. Thus I brought it up at ANI that SPECIFICO's motivation for disrupting the project seemed to be more animus of me personally (as others have noted in the ANI, on the GGTF talk page, on his talk page and even here). (Note I had intended to take other action regarding SPECIFICO on the Wikihounding issue, but this seemed the more pressing matter.) '''[[User:Carolmooredc|Carolmooredc]] ([[User talk:Carolmooredc|Talkie-Talkie]])''' 19:34, 9 September 2014 (UTC) ::::User:Sitush wrote on [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=619062389&oldid=619061084 User:Talk Jimbo Wales]: ''The sooner the misconceived "Task Force" (why not "Project", instead of a military-inspired term that implies official status?) is disbanded, the sooner harmony will be restored.'' He still posts at the project. (Also [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Countering systemic bias]] lists ''seven'' "task forces".) '''[[User:Carolmooredc|Carolmooredc]] ([[User talk:Carolmooredc|Talkie-Talkie]])''' 18:18, 13 September 2014 (UTC) :::::If Admins would just page ban the people opposed to and/or disrupting the project there would be no need for arbitration- but some people want it! ([[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/Incidents#ArbCom|1]]), ([https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Incidents&diff=625957687&oldid=625957479 2]) '''[[User:Carolmooredc|Carolmooredc]] ([[User talk:Carolmooredc|Talkie-Talkie]])''' 14:11, 17 September 2014 (UTC) :::::::Sorry to go over 500: But except for some minor lingering echoes, problems at GGTF seem to be over, including because others brought ANIs regarding two editors posting there. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 14:00, 17 September 2014 (UTC) *The Gender Gap Task Force is, in my opinion, somewhat different from the other WikiProjects, in that, to some extent, it is political in nature (and I'm using the term "political" ''latu sensu''): I mean, the members of the Task Force are considering changes aimed at increasing the number of women editing Wikipedia and, assuming they are successful in proposing feasible innovations, these will have an impact over Wikipedia in its entirety. Case in point, the proposal to make edits made by women harder to revert. For that reason, I can see how having someone criticising proposals and possibly presenting alternatives can be useful for the project and can also prevent the Task Force from becoming an echo chamber. Of course, there is a difference between criticism and disruption: if, after review, it turns out that a person's actions are disrupting the Task Force, then that person should be asked to leave {{Endash}} and, failing that, be topic banned from participating further. On the other hand, the other members of the Task Force should be open to criticism, when made in good faith, without confusing criticism with disruption and calling for sanctions merely because someone disagrees with them {{endash}} and also, though this is just my unsolicited opinion, in general all participants should try to avoid letting their voice drown all the others, regardless of how strongly they feel about the issue at hand.

In this case, in my opinion, both sides have conducted themselves in a way that bears review, so I vote to '''accept''' the case. '''[[User:Salvio giuliano|Salvio]]''' [[User talk:Salvio giuliano|Let's talk about it!]] 09:18, 9 September 2014 (UTC) *There's certainly problems with the Gender Gap on Wikipedia, one that was a key focus for the Foundation last year (or was it the year before?) As it's such a "big" issue, tying outside problems like societal bias and technical issues with behaviour on Wikipedia, I'm not sure it can ever be solved. However, the Gender Gap Task Force is there to try and good on them for doing so.

I've seen some "blue-sky thinking" on that task force, with "un-wiki" ideas such as requiring consensus of 2 editors to revert a female editor. "Blue-sky thinking" is all well and good, but many people don't understand that it's the first step in a process. After the ideas are created, however "out-there" they may be, they need to be criticised - it needs to be discussed what is wrong with these ideas. If there was nothing wrong with them, they would be happening or very easy to implement. From there, a pragmatic view should be taken on what realistic improvement can be made. Without these following steps, "blue-sky thinking" can actually be harmful - insulting those who are working hard on a project and demoralising those who cannot see these ideas come to fruition.

Whilst I'm very happy that the Gender Gap Task Force is trying to increase the number of women on Wikipedia, I'm not happy with the fact that a subset of that task force is complaining about the criticism that they are receiving. Similarly, I believe the level of criticism could be improved, actually explaining where the issues are are rather than stating that they won't work.

Overall, I don't believe this issues is ripe for arbitration, but I do think it's getting close. I'm leaning decline, but am willing to be persuaded otherwise. at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' === Two kinds of pork === 9) {{userlinks|Two kinds of pork}} has been disruptive in areas relating to the Gender gap task force,[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Countering_systemic_bias/Gender_gap_task_force&diff=prev&oldid=624947054][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Scottywong&diff=prev&oldid=625335692] for which they received a short block in September 2014.[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Two_kinds_of_pork&diff=625134458&oldid=625045689] They have also baited and used sexualized innuendo.[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Countering_systemic_bias/Gender_gap_task_force&diff=627631778&oldid=627629139][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Countering_systemic_bias/Gender_gap_task_force&diff=628001970&oldid=627990886][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:WikiProject_Countering_systemic_bias/Gender_gap_task_force&diff=623289971&oldid=623289105] (including edit summary) [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=prev&oldid=625293435] (including edit summary) :''Passed 9 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''All remedies that refer to a period of time (for example, a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months) are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' === Scope of topic bans (rescinded) === 1) Editors topic banned by the Committee under this remedy are prohibited on the English Wikipedia from: (i) editing the pages of the Gender Gap Task Force; (ii) discussing the gender disparity among Wikipedians; and (iii) participating in any process broadly construed to do with these topics. An uninvolved admin may remove any comments that breach this remedy, and impose blocks as necessary. The Committee's standard provisions on [[Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Procedures#Standard provision: enforcement of restrictions|enforcement of arbitration provisions]] and [[Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Procedures#Standard provision: appeals and modifications|appeals and modifications of arbitration enforcements]] apply. :''Passed 11 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ::''Rescinded and [[#Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope) - February 2015|replaced]] by [[Special:Permalink/646028114#Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope)|motion]] at 12:29, 7 February 2015 (UTC)'' ===Carolmooredc topic banned=== 2) {{userlinks|Carolmooredc}} is indefinitely topic banned from the [[#Scope of topic bans|Gender gap topic]]. :''Passed 10 to 2 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Carolmooredc banned=== 2.1) For her actions discussed in this case, {{userlinks|Carolmooredc}} is indefinitely banned from the English Language Wikipedia. She may request reconsideration of the ban twelve months after the enactment of this remedy, and every twelve months thereafter. :''Passed 10 to 2 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Eric Corbett topic banned=== 3) {{userlinks|Eric Corbett}} is indefinitely topic banned from the [[#Scope of topic bans|Gender gap topic]]. :''Passed 8 to 2, with 2 abstentions, at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ::{{clerk note}} A [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Arbitration enforcement 2#Enforcement of Eric Corbett's sanctions (alternative)|remedy]] of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Arbitration enforcement 2|Arbitration enforcement 2]] case {{tq|mandates that all enforcement requests relating to [these sanctions] be filed at [[WP:AE|arbitration enforcement]] and be kept open for at least 24 hours.}} ''Passed at 02:39, 25 December 2015 (UTC)'' === Eric Corbett prohibited === 3.3) [[User:Eric Corbett|Eric Corbett]] agrees to a restriction prohibiting him from shouting at, swearing at, insulting and/or belittling other editors. The restriction comes into immediate effect on the passing of this motion.

If Eric Corbett finds himself tempted to engage in prohibited conduct, he is to [[Wikipedia:Dispute resolution#Disengage|disengage]] and either let the matter drop or refer it to another editor to resolve.

If however, in the opinion of an uninvolved administrator, Eric Corbett does engage in prohibited conduct, he may be blocked. The first two such blocks shall be of 72 hours duration, increasing thereafter for each subsequent breach to one week, one month, and three months. Any blocks under this provision are arbitration enforcement actions and may only be reviewed or appealed at the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement|arbitration enforcement noticeboard]]. Should a fifth block (three months) prove necessary, the blocking administrator must notify the Arbitration Committee of the block via a [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Clarification and Amendment|Request for Clarification and Amendment]] so that the remedy may be reviewed.

The enforcing administrator may also at their discretion fully protect Eric Corbett's talk page for the duration of the block.

Nothing in this remedy prevents enforcement of policy by uninvolved administrators in the usual way. :''Passed 8 to 2, with 1 abstentions, at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ::{{clerk note}} A [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Arbitration enforcement 2#Enforcement of Eric Corbett's sanctions (alternative)|remedy]] of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Arbitration enforcement 2|Arbitration enforcement 2]] case {{tq|mandates that all enforcement requests relating to [these sanctions] be filed at [[WP:AE|arbitration enforcement]] and be kept open for at least 24 hours.}} ''Passed at 02:39, 25 December 2015 (UTC)'' ===Neotarf topic banned=== 4) {{userlinks|Neotarf}} is indefinitely topic banned from the [[#Scope of topic bans|Gender gap topic]]. Neotarf is also warned that complaints about usernames should be made through appropriate channels and that further accusations, as well as unnecessary antagonism, may result in sanctions. :''Passed 7 to 3, with 1 abstentions, at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Neotarf banned=== 4.1) For their actions discussed in this case, and in particular for adopting a consistently hostile attitude to other contributors, {{userlinks|Neotarf}} is indefinitely banned from the English Wikipedia. They may request reconsideration of the ban twelve months after the enactment of this remedy, and every twelve months thereafter. :''Passed 9 to 1, with 2 abstentions, at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Sitush warned=== 5) {{userlinks|Sitush}} is warned not to create articles regarding editors he is in dispute with. :''Passed 10 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Sitush and Carolmooredc interaction ban=== 6) {{user|Sitush}} and {{user|Carolmooredc}} are indefinitely prohibited from [[WP:IBAN|interacting with, or commenting on]], each other anywhere on Wikipedia (subject to the [[Wikipedia:Banning policy#Exceptions to limited bans|ordinary exceptions]]). :''Passed 11 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===SPECIFICO=== 7) The Arbitration Committee endorses the community-imposed [[WP:IBAN|one-way interaction ban]] preventing {{userlinks|SPECIFICO}} from interacting with Carolmooredc.[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive854#SPECIFICO.27s_WP:WIKIHOUNDING_of_Carolmooredc_-_Proposal_of_Two_Way_Interaction_Ban][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:SPECIFICO&diff=prev&oldid=625519985] It is converted to an Arbitration Committee-imposed ban, and enforcement of the ban should be discussed at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement]]. SPECIFICO is cautioned that if they continue to disrupt and breach restrictions, they may be subject to increasingly severe sanctions. :''Passed 7 to 2 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' === Two kinds of pork topic banned === 8) {{userlinks|Two kinds of pork}} is indefinitely topic banned from the [[#Scope of topic bans|Gender gap topic]]. :''Passed 9 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ===Discretionary sanctions (rescinded) === 9) [[WP:AC/DS|Standard discretionary sanctions]] are authorized for pages relating to the [[Wikipedia:Gender gap task force|Gender gap task force]]. The availability of sanctions is not intended to prevent free and candid discussion on these pages, but sanctions should be imposed if an editor severely or persistently disrupts the discussion. :''Passed 11 to 0 at 08:37, 1 December 2014 (UTC)'' ::''Rescinded and [[#Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope) - February 2015|replaced]] by [[Special:Permalink/646028114#Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope)|motion]] at 12:29, 7 February 2015 (UTC)'' ==Amendments== ===Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope) - February 2015=== {{Ivmbox|1=[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Interactions at GGTF]] is amended as follows: # The provisions in the "'''{{vanchor|Scope of topic bans}}'''" remedy are rescinded and replaced with: "Editors topic banned by the Committee under this remedy are prohibited on the English Wikipedia from editing any pages relating to or making any edit about: (i) the Gender Gap Task Force; (ii) the gender disparity among Wikipedians; and (iii) any process or discussion relating to these topics, all broadly construed. An uninvolved admin may remove any comments that breach this remedy, and impose blocks as necessary. The Committee's standard provisions on [[Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Procedures#Standard provision: enforcement of restrictions|enforcement of arbitration provisions]] and [[Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Procedures#Standard provision: appeals and modifications|appeals and modifications of arbitration enforcements]] apply." # The terms of the "'''{{vanchor|Discretionary sanctions}}'''" remedy are rescinded and replaced with: "Discretionary sanctions are authorised for any page relating to or any edit about: (i) the Gender Gap Task Force; (ii) the gender disparity among Wikipedians; and (iii) any process or discussion relating to these topics, all broadly construed ." # All sanctions already issued under earlier versions of these provisions remain in force. }} :''Passed 9 to 0, with 1 abstention, by [[Special:Permalink/646028114#Motion: Interactions at GGTF (amend scope)|motion]] at 12:29, 7 February 2015 (UTC)'' ===Motion: Manning naming dispute (February 2019)=== {{Ivmbox|1=To consolidate and clarify gender-related discretionary sanctions, the Arbitration Committee resolves that: # [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Manning_naming_dispute#Discretionary_sanctions_applicable|Remedy 15]] of the {{ArbCase|Manning naming dispute}} case is amended to read: #:{{tq|The [[WP:AC/DS|standard discretionary sanctions]] adopted in [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Sexology]] [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/GamerGate]] for (among other things) "all articles dealing with transgender issues" "all edits about, and all pages related to ... any gender-related dispute or controversy" and associated persons remain in force. For the avoidance of doubt, these discretionary sanctions apply to any dispute regarding the proper article title, pronoun usage, or other manner of referring to any individual known to be or self-identifying as transgender, including but not limited to Chelsea/Bradley Manning. Any sanctions imposed should be logged at the ''Sexology'' ''GamerGate'' case, not this one.}} # Clause 2 of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Interactions_at_GGTF#Motion:_Interactions_at_GGTF_(amend_scope)_-_February_2015|February 2015 motion]] at the {{ArbCase|Interactions at GGTF}} case is struck and rescinded. Nothing in this motion provides grounds for appeal of remedies or restrictions imposed while discretionary sanctions were in force. Such appeals or requests to lift or modify such sanctions may be made under the same terms as any other appeal. # The following amendment is added to the {{ArbCase|Interactions at GGTF}} case: #:{{tq|The [[WP:AC/DS|standard discretionary sanctions]] adopted in [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/GamerGate]] for (among other things) "all edits about, and all pages related to ... any gender-related dispute or controversy" remain in force. For the avoidance of doubt, these discretionary sanctions apply to any discussion regarding systemic bias faced by female editors or article subjects on Wikipedia, including any discussion involving the Gender Gap Task Force. Any sanctions imposed should be logged at the GamerGate case, not this one.}}}} :''Passed 5 to 1 with 1 abstention by [[Special:Permalink/884457714#Motion:_Manning_naming_dispute|motion]] at 16:35, 22 February 2019 (UTC)'' ::''Final clause of this motion is rescinded by [[Special:Permalink/1008369085#Motion: Remedy transfer to Gender and sexuality shell case|motion]] at 23:36, 22 February 2021 (UTC)'' === Motion: Remedy transfer to Gender and sexuality shell case (February 2021) === {{ivmbox|1=In order to promote consistency and reduce confusion, the arbitration clerks are directed to create a new arbitration case page under the name ''[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Gender and sexuality|Gender and sexuality]]'', with the following sole remedy: "[[Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Discretionary sanctions|Standard discretionary sanctions]] are authorized for all edits about, and all pages related to, any gender-related dispute or controversy and associated people." For the avoidance of doubt, [[GamerGate]] is considered a gender-related dispute or controversy for the purposes of this remedy. Clause (i) of [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/GamerGate#Discretionary_sanctions|Remedy 1.1]] of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/GamerGate|''GamerGate'' case]] ("Discretionary sanctions") is rescinded. Sanctions previously issued in accordance with Remedy 1.1 of the ''GamerGate'' case will from this time on be considered ''Gender and sexuality'' sanctions. This motion does not invalidate any action previously taken under the ''GamerGate'' discretionary sanctions authorization. In order to preserve previous clarifications about the scope of these discretionary sanctions: #''Gender and sexuality'' discretionary sanctions apply to any dispute regarding the proper article title, pronoun usage, or other manner of referring to any individual known to be or self-identifying as transgender. #''Gender and sexuality'' discretionary sanctions apply to any discussion regarding systemic bias faced by female editors or article subjects on Wikipedia, including any discussion involving the Gender Gap Task Force. #[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Manning_naming_dispute#Discretionary_sanctions_applicable|Remedy 15]] of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Manning naming dispute|''Manning naming dispute'' case]] ("Discretionary sanctions applicable"), as amended, is rescinded. #The final clause of the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Manning naming dispute#Motion: Manning naming dispute (February 2019)|February 2019 ''Manning naming dispute'' motion]] (adding an amendment to the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Interactions_at_GGTF|''Interactions at GGTF'' case]]) is rescinded. The index of topics with an active discretionary sanctions provision will be updated with the new title, but previous references to ''GamerGate'' need not be updated. The arbitration enforcement log, however, should be updated for the current year. For prior years, the new name should be noted along with the old one. The arbitration clerks are also directed to update templates and documentation pages with the new name as appropriate. This motion should be recorded on the case pages of the ''GamerGate'' case, the new ''Gender and sexuality'' case, the ''Manning naming dispute'' case, and the ''Interactions at GGTF'' case. }} :''Passed 11 to 0 by [[Special:Permalink/1008369085#Motion: Remedy transfer to Gender and sexuality shell case|motion]] at 23:36, 22 February 2021 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== {{Arbitration standard provisions}} ==Enforcement log== {{anchor|Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions}} Any block, restriction, ban, or sanction performed under the authorisation of a remedy for this case must be logged in this section. Please specify the administrator, date and time, nature of sanction, and basis or context. cases.title: Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/International Churches of Christ
cases.content:
'''Case Opened''' on 13:52, 28 March 2008 (UTC) '''Case Closed''' on 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)
Watchlist all case pages: [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}&action=watch '''1'''], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Evidence&action=watch '''2'''], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Workshop&action=watch '''3'''], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Proposed_decision&action=watch '''4''']
Please do not edit this page directly unless you are either 1) an Arbitrator, 2) an Arbitration Clerk, or 3) adding yourself to this case. Statements on this page are original comments provided at [[WP:RFAR|arbitration request]] and serve as opening statements. As such, they should not be altered. Any evidence you wish to provide to the Arbitrators should go on the [[/Evidence]] subpage. Arbitrators, the parties, and other editors may suggest proposed principles, findings, and remedies at [[/Workshop]]. That page may also be used for general comments on the evidence. Arbitrators will then vote on a final decision in the case at [[/Proposed decision]]. Once the case is closed, editors may add to the [[#Log of blocks and bans]] as needed, but this page should not be edited otherwise. Please raise any questions at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration#Requests for clarification]], and report violations of remedies at [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard/Arbitration enforcement]]. ==Involved parties== *{{userlinks|Xiaphias}}, ''filing party'' *{{userlinks|TransylvanianKarl}} ===Requests for comment=== [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152779326&oldid=152774425 Request for Comment Disputed article RFC] == Statement by [[user:Xiaphias|Xiaphias]] == I stumbled upon this article by chance several months ago and, finding it to be in terrible shape, authored an entirely new version.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152661628&oldid=152313785] An IP editor (presumably [[user:TransylvanianKarl|TransylvanianKarl]]; see below) promptly reverted it to its previous form.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152669004&oldid=152665786] When Karl expressed his support for the anonymous revert,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152675395&oldid=152675367] I asked him to explain his objections so that we might reach some compromise.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152750030&oldid=152675395] Among his criticisms was the fact that I'd indicated which levels of church clergy were salaried; he explained, "''Paid, and unpaid, are not neutral category, this is a hostile vievpont because, the leaders are the servant of members, and they are payd, because they work, and serving the church, the church members, and God.''"[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152754347&oldid=152753236] He added that he considered unflattering the photograph I'd uploaded of the church founder.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=152892886&oldid=152891431] Subsequently I filed a Request for Comment. Four users voiced their opinion; unanimously, they supported my revised edition. "''Your version is far, far, superior,''" wrote [[user:LtPowers|LtPowers]], "''to the point that I felt it necessary to revert back to it. It's that much better. The prior state of the article was a mess, absurdly POV, and overflowing with unduly-weighted sources. I commend your effort and hope more people notice this article to help keep POV edits out.''"[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=153389418&oldid=153308280] [[user:Pspadaro|Pspadaro]] thanked me for the work, saying of the new article, "''It is coherent and usable. It will be a great (new) starting point to expand the article as needed. I appreciate you putting in the time to make this a legitimate article.''"[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=154155983&oldid=154062190] User [[user:seektruthfromfacts|seektruthfromfacts]] noted that both versions could be improved; "However," he added, "only one has multiple reliable sources - Xiaphas' version."[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=157151997&oldid=157151865] Last to voice his opinion was [[user:Nswinton|Nswinton]], who agreed that the newer version was superior.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=157227541&oldid=157152735] A plethora of anonymous edits prevented me from effecting the agreed-upon changes; when a three-day semiprotected status was introduced, [[user:TransylvanianKarl|TransylvanianKarl]] abruptly returned to carry on the work of the IPs.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=International_Churches_of_Christ&offset=20071213083552&limit=20&action=history] I would like to recommend that [[user:TransylvanianKarl|TransylvanianKarl]] be permanently banned from editing the [[ICoC]] article page (though not its corresponding talk page), and that it receive permanent semiprotected status. Since registering in later 2006, Karl has relegated his edits exclusively to two articles: that of the International Churches of Christ and of Kip McKean, its founder.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&limit=500&contribs=user&target=TransylvanianKarl&namespace=0]. Sometimes, he'll submit hundreds of edits over the course of just a few days.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&offset=20060725085732&limit=100&contribs=user&target=TransylvanianKarl] As a self-admitted member of the organization in question,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ&diff=prev&oldid=63432925] his strong emotions (I believe) preclude him from making productive contributions. However, I would like him to be allowed access to the talk page so that he may shape the article indirectly; his perspective as an insider could undoubtedly prove to be an asset. Thank you for your time and consideration. --[[User:Xiaphias|Xiaphias]] ([[User talk:Xiaphias|talk]]) 08:32, 26 March 2008 (UTC) == Statement by [[user:TransylvanianKarl|TransylvanianKarl]] == My english is poor. It is too difficult for me. In the [[hungarian]] wikipedia aren't translated the "Requests for arbitration" -article. I think the neutrality is very important in an enciklopedy. My first problem was with Xiaphias's version the neutrality. For example this is POV!: ''"is a controversial Protestant sect which splintered from the mainline Churches of Christ"'' This is a non neutral sentence! The neutrality is not an option in the wikipedia! My second problem was with Xiaphias's version:''' vandalism'''. Xiaphias vandalized the original version, he deleted a lot of information without, discussion. This is not okay, because [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:International_Churches_of_Christ/Archive1 the original version was discussed from 2005 to 2007.] I think when we have two version, have to merge this two. '''Exchange the aricle without, discussion?''' I dont know of the kind rule in the wikipedia. About my conviction "[[Wikipedia:Requests for comment]]" don't substitute the minute work and the discussion of sections one by one!!!! Today and yesterday I worked a lot on merge this two version, I think I made a balanced article now. But it is very important the NPOV in the whole article, and the criticism section too.!!! --[[User:TransylvanianKarl|TransylvanianKarl]] ([[User talk:TransylvanianKarl|talk]]) 11:46, 28 March 2008 (UTC) ==Preliminary decisions== ===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (5/0/0/0)=== * Accept. [[User:Sam Blacketer|Sam Blacketer]] ([[User talk:Sam Blacketer|talk]]) 10:08, 27 March 2008 (UTC) * Accept, I think we can help sort this out. [[User:FloNight|FloNight]][[User talk:FloNight|♥♥♥]] 11:01, 27 March 2008 (UTC) * Accept. [[User:Kirill Lokshin|Kirill]] 13:01, 27 March 2008 (UTC) * Accept, given that prior attempts at dispute resolution have broken down, though parties should be aware that, as has always been the case, we will not ourselves be making any content decisions here. --[[User:Thebainer|bainer]] ([[User_talk:Thebainer|talk]]) 13:24, 27 March 2008 (UTC) * Accept, although I will reevaluate if TransylvanianKarl makes a statement before tomorrow when the case is due to open. I have left a note on his talkpage regarding status of the request. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 21:41, 27 March 2008 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision= ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]], where vote counts and comments are also available.'' ==Principles== ===Editorial process=== 1) Wikipedia works by building [[Wikipedia:consensus|consensus]] through the use of polite discussion. The [[Wikipedia:Dispute resolution|dispute resolution process]], including [[Wikipedia:requests for comment|requests for comment]], is designed to assist consensus-building when normal talk page communication has not worked. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Edit-warring considered harmful=== 2) Edit-warring is harmful. When disagreements arise, users are expected to discuss their differences rationally rather than reverting ad infinitum. Revert rules should not be construed as an entitlement or inalienable right to revert, nor do they endorse reverts as an editing technique. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Neutral point of view=== 3) Wikipedia articles are to be written from a [[Wikipedia:neutral point of view|neutral point of view]] and without bias, and must not contain [[WP:SOAP|advocacy]] for any organization, cause, or belief. Assertions of fact, particularly controversial ones, should be supported by citation to [[Wikipedia:reliable sources|reliable sources]]. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Conflict of interest=== 4) Editors who have or may be perceived as having a [[Wikipedia:conflict of interest|conflict of interest]] should review and comply with the conflict of interest policy. The conflicts policy does not prohibit editors from working on articles about entities to which they have only an indirect relationship, but urges that editors be mindful of editing pitfalls that may result from such a relationship. For example, an editor who is a member of a particular organization or holds a particular set of religious or other beliefs is not prohibited from editing articles concerning that organization or those beliefs. However, such an editor should take care that his or her editing on that topic adheres to NPOV and other policies. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Sockpuppetry and IP editing=== 5) The use of [[Wikipedia:Sock puppetry|sockpuppet]] accounts, while not generally forbidden, is discouraged. Abuse of sockpuppet accounts, such as editing the same article from more than one account, is prohibited. A registered user's editing the same article from the user's registered account and from IP addresses has the same ill-effects as editing from a main and a sockpuppet account, and therefore is also prohibited. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Assuming good faith=== 6) Editors, including members of the Arbitration Committee, should [[Wikipedia:assume good faith|assume good faith]] concerning the editing of other contributors, even where those contributors have made mistakes or violated policies, until there is cogent evidence to the contrary. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Non-native speakers=== 7) Appropriate allowance should be made for editors whose native language is not English, so long as their overall contributions are of benefit to the project, and extra efforts should be made to explain our policies and procedures to such editors. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Disruptive editing=== 8) The editing of users who disrupt editing by edit-warring or aggressive sustained point-of-view editing may be restricted through measures such as topic bans or revert limitations. Where unavoidable, such measures will be imposed even where a user appears to be acting in good faith, for the benefit of other contributors and the project as a whole. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' == Findings of fact == ===Locus of dispute=== 1) The locus of dispute is the article [[International Churches of Christ]], and in particular the editing of this article by {{User|TransylvanianKarl}}. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===TransylvanianKarl=== 2) TransylvanianKarl has edited Wikipedia since March 2006. He has never been blocked or otherwise sanctioned. A majority of TransylvanianKarl's contributions to Wikipedia are to [[International Churches of Christ]] and closely related pages. TransylvanianKarl self-identifies on-wiki as a member of that church. He has also stated on-wiki that he is not a native speaker of English, that his English skills are limited, and that his native language is Hungarian. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Problematic editing=== 3) Over a sustained period of time, TransylvanianKarl has edited [[International Churches of Christ]] [[Wikipedia:disruptive editing|disruptively]], including edits reflecting a biased point of view and advocacy, repeated reversions without discussion, replacement of reliable sources with less reliable ones, failure to seek consensus in the face of disagreements, and unexplained removal of cited material and citations. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===IP editing=== 4) As suggested from the article history and confirmed as likely by CheckUser, TransylvanianKarl appears to have edited [[International Churches of Christ]] from a number of IP addresses as well as from his registered account. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Additional findings=== 5) TransylvanianKarl has [[Wikipedia talk:Requests for arbitration/International Churches of Christ/Evidence|explained]] that because of his limited English, he is having difficulty participating in the arbitration proceedings. His [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/International Churches of Christ#Statement by TransylvanianKarl|statement]] in the case reflects some understanding of core policies such as NPOV and a desire to follow them, but the record suggests that he would benefit from further review and better understanding of the relevant policies and norms. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Conclusions=== 6) We conclude that the case is best resolved through flexible remedies designed to maximize the possibility of useful editing from this contributor, who has not previously been sanctioned, while protecting the best interests of the encyclopedia and other users. We have considered suspending the case pending TransylvanianKarl's receiving language assistance, but conclude that his and other editors' time would be more fruitfully spent in trying to improve his editing skills, rather than in mastering the nuances of participating in an arbitration case. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===TransylvanianKarl urged and instructed=== 1) TransylvanianKarl is urged to refrain from editing [[International Churches of Christ]] and any related pages until he has fully familiarized himself with the English Wikipedia core policies mentioned in this decision, including [[Wikipedia:Neutral point of view]], [[Wikipedia:Consensus]], [[Wikipedia:Verifiability]], and [[Wikipedia:Conflict of interest]]. TransylvanianKarl is instructed to comply with these and other applicable policies in his future editing. TransylvanianKarl is also urged to raise issues and suggestions on the talkpage before making potentially controversial edits to articles, including deletion of cited material and citations. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===TransylvanianKarl restricted=== 2) TransylvanianKarl is instructed to edit [[International Churches of Christ]] and related articles only through his registered account and not from a not-logged-in IP address. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Future disruptive editing=== 3) Should TransylvanianKarl continue to edit [[International Churches of Christ]] or related pages disruptively despite the guidance provided by this decision, any uninvolved administrator may, after a warning, impose a reasonable restriction upon him such as a revert restriction or temporary page ban. Should chronic problems continue, a request may be filed on [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration]] after 30 days requesting that this committee reopen this decision and impose more restrictive remedies. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ===Assistance invited=== 4) Editors fluent in Hungarian are encouraged to assist TransylvanianKarl in complying with these remedies and to answer any questions he may have concerning Wikipedia policies, his editing, or this decision. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== ===Enforcement=== 1) Should TransylvanianKarl violate any restriction imposed by an administrator under authority of this decision, he may be blocked for an appropriate period of time of up to one week. After five blocks, the maximum block time is increased to one year. See also remedy 3 providing for reopening of this decision if necessary. :''passed 8 to 0, 19:35, 12 April 2008 (UTC)'' ==Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions== Log any block, restriction, ban or extension under any remedy in this decision here. Minimum information includes name of administrator, date and time, what was done and the basis for doing it. [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}

{{ombox | type = notice | image = [[File:Ambox warning blue.svg|55px|link=|alt=]] | text = '''This case is closed. No edits should be made to this page except by clerks or arbitrators.''' *Any violations of the remedies passed in the case should be raised at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement]]. *Specific requests for amendment or clarification about the decision should be raised at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Clarification and Amendment]]. *General questions can be raised at [[Wikipedia talk:Arbitration Committee]]. *Actions taken to enforce remedies authorised in the case (if applicable) are to be logged at the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration enforcement log|centralised arbitration enforcement log]].}} == Case information == === Involved parties === *{{userlinks|Idealigic}}, ''filing party'' *{{userlinks|Mhhossein}} *{{userlinks|Vice regent}} *{{userlinks|Stefka Bulgaria}} *{{userlinks|BarcrMac}} *{{userlinks|Alex-h}} ===Prior dispute resolution=== *[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive1004#Iranian_opposition_articles Link 1] *[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Archive334#Help_needed_with_possible_violation Link 2] *[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran#CRP_violation_report Link 3] == Preliminary statements == === Statement by Idealigic === [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive1004#Iranian_opposition_articles Link 1] shows a 2019 WP:ANI dispute where Mhhossein and Stefka Bulgaria were strongly warned against making personal attacks, treating Wikipedia as a battleground, and edit-warring in articles related to political oppositions to the current regime in Iran. Then [[WP:GS/IRANPOL]] seems to have been created to also help in this topic area, leading to blocks of several editors. Also a [[WP:CRP]] restriction to stop edit warring in this topic was implemented in [[People’s Mujahedin of Iran]]. * Despite all of this, Mhhossein is still continuing to treat the talk page at [[People’s Mujahedin of Iran]] as a battleground and trying to [[WP:GAME]] the consensus building there. Mhhossein’s has received many warnings about this ([https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Mhhossein&diff=886743553&oldid=886082221][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=944736897&oldid=944735804][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=940471241&oldid=940470596][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=958408102&oldid=958407285][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=911713752&oldid=911710472][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=913543626&oldid=913481453]) and was [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Log/block&page=User%3AMhhossein blocked for 3 months] for tendentious editing in a related article. * Mhhossein treating the talk page as a battleground through Uncivil comments:[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=938950969&oldid=938950690][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=986488751&oldid=986487886][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1001153956&oldid=1001152942][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Mhhossein&diff=806824188&oldid=806797128][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1019129758&oldid=1019111185] * Mhhossein makes false claims of being the victim of “personal attacks” and “harassment”: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Mhhossein&diff=806258469&oldid=806252416] [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=986487886&oldid=986484446] [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=899651280&oldid=899650657][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=899786927&oldid=899740728][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=949221550&oldid=949220988][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=935160849&oldid=935159740][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=986487886&oldid=986484446][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=961747738&oldid=961732913] * Mhhossein trying to invalidate RfCs on the article’s talk page:[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_44#Nonsense_About_RFCs_as_Shortcut][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=939951027&oldid=939896044][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=981503352&oldid=981447601][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1026775817&oldid=1026774631][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1011000297&oldid=1010999407] * Mhhossein often makes false reports against editors with opposing views (mainly myself and Stefka Bulgaria). [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1024125443&oldid=1024105648][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran#CRP_violation_report][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=944097067&oldid=944095061][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_25#Ypatch%27s_violation_of_the_restriction][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=936495737&oldid=936495718][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=950360168&oldid=950360045] * Mhhossein edit warring (making multiple [[WP:CRP]] violations) and tendentious editing: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran#Past_CRP_violations_by_Mhhossein][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=947254889&oldid=947253981][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=947328200&oldid=947327602][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1002890959&oldid=1002848926] * Mhhossein [[WP:Stonewalling]]: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=958408102&oldid=958407285][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1004640734&oldid=1004609451][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1010848761&oldid=1010847568][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1024154583&oldid=1024154464] * Mhhossein trying to create section headings or synth information in a misleading way: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1008071863&oldid=1008036824] * Mhhossein’s [[WP:SEALION]]ing: Mhhossein's apparent agenda involves putting as much slanderous material as they can add to the article (even though the article is already filled with such content) while removing as many opposing narratives as possible: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=891825978&oldid=891820076][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=907662430&oldid=907661739][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_19#Recent_revert_by_Mhhossein][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=941151364&oldid=941150176][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=949099526&oldid=949091658][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_35#Removal_of_the_casualties_on_the_77_Khorassan_Division][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1007246974&oldid=1007245041][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=961429067&oldid=961413303][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=975641064&oldid=975640223] * Mhhossein sometimes uses very questionable sources for this: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=943916243&oldid=943915839][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=913803349&oldid=913797979] [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=987985561&oldid=987822209], or critiques reliable sources when these don’t suit their POV: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=921733313&oldid=921702170][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=922676294&oldid=922668470], or [[WP:SYNTH]]s information from sources: [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=982338046&oldid=982329727][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=940816331&oldid=940792296][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1005799056&oldid=1005769236]. Vice regent has been as persistent as Mhhossein in trying to fill the article with as much slanderous content as possible while trying to exclude opposing narratives (although VR's overall approach tends to be more subtle and polite): [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=982472545&oldid=982338046][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=973298924&oldid=973294212][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=976494732&oldid=976493034][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=976839002&oldid=976739624][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=991934973&oldid=991934120][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=989747678&oldid=989671375][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=993248808&oldid=993234396][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Vanamonde93&diff=prev&oldid=1008305614] VR has also been a very persistent edit warrior at [[People’s Mujahedin of Iran]]. For example, the most recent WP:AN case ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Archive334#Help_needed_with_possible_violation Link 2]) where Vice regent broke the article’s WP:CRP restrictions while Mhhossein tried to falsely blame me and Stefka Bulgaria for this (there {{u|El_C}} suggested that it may be time to bring this to Arbitration). After this, VR continued edit warring making another [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1031436193&oldid=1031434607 CRP violation], and I [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1031588197&oldid=1031588061 warned them] that if they made another CRP violation I would have to report it, and they did [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1032972476&oldid=1032861609 made another CRP violation]. That's 3 CRP violations in a less than a month, with even two mysterious IPs making another CRP violation in favour of Mhhossein's and VR's POV pushing (with both Mhhossein and VR defending the IP when I tried to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran#Admin_assistance_needed report] it). Since all regards for policy seem to have gone out the window in that article (and admins don’t seem to want to get involved there anymore) I agree with El_C that it may be time for Arbitration. === Statement by Mhhossein === Well, my "[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1033260995&oldid=1033258672 optimized solution]" which I suggested to Vice Regent included something like an Arbcom report. However, as El_C [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case&diff=prev&oldid=1033576735 mentioned], the report is not showing the important details and developments. Anyway, I guess we can not address the developments of MEK page without considering the history of the page and the fact that this page had been of a great interest to pro-MEK users and socks ("''It seems to be a fact that the socks are always here to defend the MEK (People's Mujahedin)''"– quote from [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=869836034 an uninvolved admin]). I would not expect such an unsual presence from the pro-MEK accounts when I [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=847780324 did] make my first edit on the talk page of the article. At the time, I did not know that a dozens of those pro-MEK socks were [[Wikipedia:Sockpuppet investigations/Atlantic12/Archive|identified]] by [[User:TheTimesAreAChanging|TheTimesAreAChanging]]. Add to this, [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Sockpuppet_investigations/BarcrMac&diff=prev&oldid=961201922 my well-evidenced report]. [[User:Alex-h|Alex-h]] ([[User talk:Alex-h|talk]]) 17:05, 17 July 2021 (UTC) === Statement by Vanamonde93 === I apologize for a slow response to the pings; I have been offline for a while. Consequentially, virtually all talk-page discussions I am aware of have devolved into endless stone-walling. First, please do not restrict the case to the behavior of the four named parties. I would recommend that the behavior of every active user who has participated in more than two substantive discussions about the MEK be examined here. Second, here, as in many cases about politics, the line between content and conduct has blurred; particularly after {{U|El_C}} and I levied a number of sanctions, the worst behavior has taken the form of cherry-picking sources favorable to one POV, or ignoring those favorable to the opposite. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 21:19, 20 July 2021 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision = == Principles == === Purpose of Wikipedia === 1) The purpose of Wikipedia is to create a high-quality, free-content online encyclopedia. This is best achieved in an atmosphere of collegiality, camaraderie, and mutual respect among contributors. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === National and territorial disputes === 2) Several of Wikipedia's most bitter disputes have revolved around national or ethnic conflicts such as rival national claims to disputed territories or areas. Editors working on articles on these topics may frequently have strong viewpoints, often originating in their own national or other backgrounds. Such editors may be the most knowledgeable people interested in creating Wikipedia content about the area or the dispute, and are permitted and encouraged to contribute if they can do so consistent with Wikipedia's fundamental policies. However, conduct that furthers a preexisting dispute on Wikipedia should receive special attention from the community, up to and including sanctions. It is perfectly possible to present a balanced, accurate, and verifiable encyclopedia article about contentious issues or preexisting disputes. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Neutral point of view and undue weight === 3) All Wikipedia articles must be written from a neutral point of view, with all relevant points of view represented in reasonable proportion to their importance and relevance to the subject-matter of the article. Undue weight should not be given to aspects which are peripheral to the topic. Relying on synthesized claims, poor sources, including opinion pieces, or original research is also contrary to this principle. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Consensus === 4) Wikipedia works by building consensus through the use of dispute resolution and polite discussion, with a shared receptiveness to compromise. This may involve the wider community, if necessary, through dispute resolution mechanisms like noticeboards and Requests for Comment. Individual editors have a responsibility to help debate succeed and move forward by discussing their differences rationally and by respecting the outcomes of reached after dispute resolution. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Civility === 5) Editors are expected to show [[wikipedia:Civility|reasonable courtesy]] to one another, even during contentious situations and disagreements, and not resort to [[wikipedia:No_personal_attacks|personal attacks]]. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Personalising disputes === 6) In content disputes, editors must always comment on the content and not the contributor. Personalising content disputes disrupts the consensus-building process on which Wikipedia depends. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Discussion of content === 7) Wikipedia discussions are about [[wikipedia:Consensus|forming a consensus]], not convincing [[WP:UNANIMOUS|everyone to agree]]. Discussion is an important part of how consensus is reached on Wikipedia and everyone should have the opportunity to express their views, within [[wikipedia:CIVIL|reasonable limits]]. It may be taken as [[wikipedia:DISRUPTSIGNS|disruptive]] to attempt [[wikipedia:STONEWALL|stalling out the consensus-building process]] by repeatedly stating an opinion or with [[wikipedia:LISTEN|repeated demands for re-explanation]] of that which has already been clearly explained. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === General sanctions === 8) Community-authorized general sanctions are imposed on certain contentious and strife-torn topics to create an acceptable and collaborative editing environment. Such sanctions [[wikipedia:General_sanctions#Authorisation|often follow]] the model of discretionary sanctions as imposed by the Arbitration Committee, which allows administrators to impose a variety of reasonable measures on users or articles that are necessary and proportionate for the smooth running of the project. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' == Findings of fact == === Locus of dispute & background === 1) This case concerns editing around [[Politics of Iran|Iranian politics]] with a particular focus on editing about the [[People's Mujahedin of Iran]] (MEK). In recent years there have been dozens of talk page debates and RfCs regarding wording for these topics. Discussions are dogged by accusations of sockpuppetry, attempts to subvert consensus, and POV-pushing. The topic was placed under General Sanctions and several editors have been topic-banned; however, the conflict continues. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Dispute resolution === 2) There have been multiple attempts at using [[wikipedia:DR|dispute resolution]] options in this topic area, including Requests for Comments and use of content noticeboards. These attempts at dispute resolution have not been effective (e.g. [[wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Iranian_politics/Evidence#Some_final_thoughts_before_the_clock_runs_out|El C's evidence]]. [[wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Iranian_politics/Evidence#Many_users_have_engaged_in_stonewalling_and_whataboutism|Vanamonde's evidence]]). These attempts have sometimes suffered from repetitive topics (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_33#RfC_about_more_allegations_from_former_MEK_members][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_37#RfC_about_more_allegations_from_former_MEK_members_%282nd_RfC%29]) or low participation (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Reliable_sources/Noticeboard/Archive_345&oldid=1042029428#Can_we_say,_in_Wikipedia's_voice,_that_Iraq_was_involved_in_Iran-Iraq_war_operations_that_it_denies_having_a_role_in?]). Many have failed to reach consensus (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran/Archive_39#RfC_about_removing_contentious_content_from_the_lede][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Archive329#Requesting_RfC_be_re-closed]). Parties to the case have regularly challenged the close of RfCs (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk:L235/Archive_14#RfC][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/Archive329#Requesting_RfC_be_re-closed]) :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === BarcrMac === 3) {{u|BarcrMac}} has engaged in [[wikipedia:TE|tendentious editing]] in the topic area. He has engaged in edit warring which led two blocks. He was given 3 month topic ban for his misuse of sources.[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:General_sanctions/Post-1978_Iranian_politics&diff=972534390&oldid=969318199] Since the expiration of his topic ban he has returned to the topic area stonewalling discussions to attempt to achieve his preferred point of view regardless of the content of sources used in claims.([[wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Iranian_politics/Evidence#Evidence_presented_by_Vanamonde93|Vanamonde's evidence]], [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=1021663616&oldid=1021627534]). :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Idealigic === 4) {{u|Idealigic}} has engaged in battleground editing. They have bludgeoned and stonewalled discussions (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive1051#Wholesale_removals_of_reliable_information_from_political_article_with_1RR_restrictions] [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1027582534#Meeting_with_Tariq_Aziz]). They have frequently engaged in [[whataboutism]] (e.g. [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=981994660], [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1023784212] [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=981994660]). :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Mhhossein === 5) {{u|Mhhossein}} has engaged in battleground and uncivil behavior. [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=957142041][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=991136182][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=991662256][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1001152942][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1004000780] :''Passed 11 to 2 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Stefka Bulgaria === 6) {{u|Stefka Bulgaria}} has engaged in bludgeoning, stonewalling, and degrading of discussions. They have filed verbose RfCs in an attempt to railroad preferred changes,[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=prev&oldid=981445049][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=prev&oldid=932869751] regardless of the content of sources used in claims.[https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=prev&oldid=980105275&diffmode=source][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:People%27s_Mujahedin_of_Iran&diff=prev&oldid=1007502833&diffmode=source] :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Vice regent === 7) {{u|Vice regent}} has at times shown a civil battleground mentality [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1027274304][https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=973294212] including a violation of a consensus required restriction. [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?diff=prev&oldid=1032965795#June_7_break] :''Passed 11 to 2 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' == Remedies == ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===Contentious topic designation=== {{cot|1=Superseded version}} {{hatnote|1=Former title: "Discretionary sanctions".}} {{shortcut|WP:ARBIRPDS|WP:IRANPOLDS}} 1) i) The community-authorized general sanctions for [[w:en:Wikipedia:General_sanctions/Post-1978_Iranian_politics|post-1978 Iranian politics]] are hereby superseded and replaced by [[wikipedia:Arbitration_Committee/Discretionary_sanctions|standard discretionary sanctions]], which are authorized for all edits about, and all pages related to, post-1978 Iranian politics, broadly construed.{{pb}}(ii) All sanctions in force when this remedy is enacted are endorsed and will become standard discretionary sanctions governed by the standard procedure from the moment of enactment.{{pb}}(iii) Notifications issued under Post-1978 Iranian politics general sanctions become [[wikipedia:ACDS#Alerts|alerts]] for twelve months from their date of issue, then expire.{{pb}}(iv) All existing and past sanctions and restrictions placed under post-1978 Iranian politics general sanctions will be transcribed by the arbitration clerks in the [[wikipedia:AELOG|arbitration enforcement log]].{{pb}}(v) Any requests for enforcement that may be open when this remedy is enacted shall proceed, but any remedy that is enacted should be enacted as a discretionary sanction.{{pb}}(vi) Administrators who have enforced the Post-1978 Iranian politics general sanctions are thanked for their work and asked to continue providing administrative assistance enforcing discretionary sanctions and at the [[wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement|arbitration enforcement noticeboard]]. :''Passed 13 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' These actions may include, but are not limited to: * moratoriums up to one year on initiating RfCs on a particular dispute, * word and/or diff limits on all RfC participants, * bans on editors who have disrupted consensus-finding from participation in a particular RfC, and * sectioned commenting rules in RfCs. :''Passed 11 to 2 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === BarcrMac topic-banned === 4) {{user|BarcrMac}} is [[wikipedia:TBAN|topic-banned]] from post-1978 Iranian politics, broadly construed. This ban may be appealed twelve months after the enactment of this remedy, and every twelve months thereafter. :''Passed 12 to 0 at 16:34, 20 September 2021 (UTC)'' === Idealigic topic-banned === 5) {{user|Idealigic}} is [[wikipedia:TBAN|topic-banned]] from post-1978 Iranian politics, broadly construed. This was clarified by a changed vote at 22:59, 17 Apr by David Gerard.  The decision outlined below stands -- [[User:Sannse|sannse]] [[User talk:Sannse|(talk)]] 23:20, 17 Apr 2005 (UTC)''

Please do not edit this page directly unless you wish to become a participant in this request. (All participants are subject to Arbitration Committee decisions, and the ArbCom will consider each participant's role in the dispute.) Comments are very welcome on the [[Wikipedia talk:{{PAGENAME}}|Talk page]], and will be read, in full. Evidence, no matter who can provide it, is very welcome at [[/Evidence]]. Evidence is more useful than comments. 

Arbitrators will be working on a proposed decision at [[/Proposed decision]].
