cases.title: Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Lapsed Pacifist
cases.content: '''Case Opened''' on 17:34, 8 February 2006 (UTC) '''Case Closed''' on 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC) Please do not edit this page directly unless you wish to become a participant in this request. (All participants are subject to Arbitration Committee decisions, and the ArbCom will consider each participant's role in the dispute.) Comments are very welcome on the [[Wikipedia talk:{{PAGENAME}}|Talk page]], and will be read, in full. Evidence, no matter who can provide it, is very welcome at [[/Evidence]]. Evidence is more useful than comments. Arbitrators will be working on evidence and suggesting proposed decisions at [[/Workshop]] and voting on proposed decisions at [[/Proposed decision]]. ==Involved parties== *{{Vandal|Lapsed_Pacifist}} *{{Admin|Jtdirl}} Lapsed Pacifist has for one year engaged in edit warring, POV editing and provocative behaviour despite appeals to stop, bans and an RfC. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=38338363&oldid=38338094 confirmation that LP has been notified.] Given that the user has ignored ''all'' appeals and ''all'' requests to follow NPOV and even begun editwarring as soon as blocks expired over and over again, there are no grounds whatsoever that any other mechanism but an enforceable ruling of the Arbcom will stop the saga. ===Requests for comment=== * [[Wikipedia:Requests for comment/Lapsed Pacifist]] === Statement by jtdirl === LP regularly adds in POV additions, subtle word changes and POV language pushing political agendas to Irish articles. This has been going on for months. He has ignored appeals to stop, demands from multiple users to stop, bans for breaching 3RR. In Northern Ireland, elements of both communities use POV terminology both to push their own political agenda and to send a "fuck you" message to the other. LP is one of the worst offenders on WP. For example, because elements of both communities use their own POV language to describe the place (Unionists use 'Ulster', Republicans 'The Six Counties' etc) WP follows a strict policy of ''only'' using the legal name, ''Northern Ireland'' and no POV alternative. LP has spent months deleting references to ''Northern Ireland'' and slotting in his own political agenda-pushing replacements, for example [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Constitutional_Autochthony&diff=38292563&oldid=38232999 ], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sinn_F%C3%A9in&diff=prev&oldid=38248239] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Troubles&diff=prev&oldid=38237943], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Irish_language_in_Northern_Ireland&diff=prev&oldid=38057556], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Social_Democratic_and_Labour_Party&diff=prev&oldid=37551417], He deliberately changes ''Loyalist'' (fringe working class Unionists associated with violence) to ''Unionist'' (the mainstream community rarely linked to violence) to provoke and offend Unionist Wikipedians [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Holy_Cross_dispute&diff=prev&oldid=38268848], adds in unsourced wild claims [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Loyalist&diff=prev&oldid=36383141], adds in propaganda for one party into articles [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Daily_Ireland&diff=prev&oldid=34883285] or heavy POV editorialising [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Irish_%28UK%29_general_election%2C_1918&diff=prev&oldid=34758152], miscategorises other people's edits as 'blanking' in edit summaries. Other examples of his edits include [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1996_Manchester_City_Centre_bombing&diff=prev&oldid=32613614], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Northern_Ireland_Policing_Board&diff=prev&oldid=30584224], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Michelle_Gildernew&diff=prev&oldid=25634013] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secretary_of_State_for_Northern_Ireland&diff=prev&oldid=22995110], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Northern_Ireland&diff=prev&oldid=22273265]. (Even while I was writing this, he produced this POV edit.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ulster_Loyalist&diff=prev&oldid=38323244]) Various articles have become bogged down in edit wars caused by his POVing.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Holy_Cross_dispute&action=history], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&curid=2192700&action=history], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Troubles&curid=30770&action=history] An example of some of his edit warring: #(cur) (last) 22:39, 27 July 2005 Djegan m (revert vandalism) #(cur) (last) 22:32, 27 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv) #(cur) (last) 10:00, 27 July 2005 Djegan m (revert) #(cur) (last) 06:59, 27 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv; please write accurate edit summaries) #(cur) (last) 22:30, 26 July 2005 Djegan m (revert sectanism and vandalism of LP) #(cur) (last) 22:28, 26 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv NPOV) #(cur) (last) 10:15, 26 July 2005 Demiurge m (rv POV term "six counties") #(cur) (last) 08:22, 26 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv NPOV) #(cur) (last) 09:53, 25 July 2005 Demiurge m (rv POV term "six counties") #(cur) (last) 06:59, 25 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv needlessly simplistic edit) #(cur) (last) 21:48, 24 July 2005 JW1805 m (rvt (corrected needlessly complex sentence structure)) #(cur) (last) 21:39, 24 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv needlessly simplistic edit) #(cur) (last) 15:37, 24 July 2005 JW1805 m (corrected needlessly complex sentence structure) #(cur) (last) 15:34, 24 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv; Restore context) #(cur) (last) 04:57, 24 July 2005 JW1805 m (simplify sentence) #(cur) (last) 04:08, 24 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv NPOV) #(cur) (last) 00:00, 23 July 2005 Demiurge m (rv POV) #(cur) (last) 23:48, 22 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (Revert edits by Djegan to last version by JavaJive) #(cur) (last) 20:27, 22 July 2005 Djegan (revert sectanism and vandalism) #(cur) (last) 20:20, 22 July 2005 JavaJive m (wikify date) #(cur) (last) 19:06, 22 July 2005 Demiurge m (rv POV) #(cur) (last) 17:37, 22 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv) #(cur) (last) 10:14, 22 July 2005 Demiurge m (rv POV) #(cur) (last) 05:18, 22 July 2005 Lapsed Pacifist (rv) While many of LP's edits are fine, in among the good ones he buries blatant POVing, provocative terminology and political agenda-pushing. Given that he has engaged in POV edit warring for one year, has refused to pay heed to complaints, refused to tone down his political agenda-pushing, has come back after blocks and picked up where he left off, there are no grounds for believing that any other form of mediation will stop him. He needs an enforceable ruling of the arbcom. Otherwise a host of Irish users will continue to have to spend much of their time constantly NPOVing his contributions and fighting edit wars with him. That is unfair on them and damaging to WP. (Apologies for the length of above. It is a complex issue running a full year.) === Statement by party 2 === (Please limit your statement to 500 words) ===Evidence & View by Djegan=== Lapsed Pacifist has continously disrupted wikipedia. In fairness he does give a very few good edits but this is seriously eclippsed by his pov warring on wikipedia. Additionally several good editors have being subjected to his warring across mainly British and Irish related articles, so it is not isolated by any means. What he does is damaging to a professional wikipedia and serious editors. Some specific examples I would like to cite include[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_universities_in_Ireland&oldid=25688659] whereby he merged the information of two articles into one whilst keeping the source of both ([[List of universities in the Republic of Ireland]] and [[List of universities in Northern Ireland]]). Yet another example is[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abbeys_and_priories_in_Ireland&oldid=29242860] whereby he copied the source ([[Abbeys and priories in the Republic of Ireland]] and [[Abbeys and priories in Northern Ireland]]). In these two cases he did not consult anyone for their opinion, simply created unified copies of two exisiting articles. I contend that this is part of his general style to be biased and pov biased; a false [[United Ireland]]. Two recent controversies he is associated in (with me) is that he moved two pages [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Northern_Ireland_national_soccer_team&action=history] and [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Republic_of_Ireland_national_soccer_team&action=history] even though the consensus was against this on the respective talk pages. These two articles are currently subject to a [[WP:RM]] vote. This is only a small example of the warring that he does. [[User:Djegan|Djegan]] 19:04, 5 February 2006 (UTC) ===Statement and evidence by [[User:Demiurge|Demiurge]]=== This user holds [[Irish republicanism|Irish republican]] views, and is of the opinion that [[Northern Ireland]] is not a legitimate political entity. Which is a perfectly legitimate opinion to hold, of course; the problem arises when he tries to push this POV on Wikipedia by inserting unofficial POV names ("north-eastern Ireland", "the six counties", "the north-east") instead of "Northern Ireland" and even by using "Ireland" or "[[Ulster]]" where "Northern Ireland" would be more specific and appropriate[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Combat_18&diff=38246386&oldid=38051635][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nigel_Dodds&diff=38238434&oldid=38055795]. Problematic behaviour includes: * provocative edit summaries: ''[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Troubles&diff=prev&oldid=36934961 "rv, for the hell of it"]'' ''[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Troubles&diff=prev&oldid=38044920 "Inserting outrageous POV"]''. Very difficult to [[WP:AGF]] after seeing these. * [[User_talk:Demiurge#Unionist_paramilitaries_(1912 - )]] — discussion on my talk page where he admits that he is changing "loyalist paramilitaries" to "unionist paramilitaries" to push his POV that loyalist paramilitary groups and the police/army in Northern Ireland are equivalent. * [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=34883135&oldid=34255508] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=36222019&oldid=34935112] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=36523185&oldid=36226134] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=36936162&oldid=36523441] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=38020847&oldid=36937403] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Demographics_and_politics_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=38234442&oldid=38023229] — revert warring over an unsourced "fact" concerning the [[Democratic Unionist Party]]'s membership, and refusing to provide evidence when [[Talk:Demographics and politics of Northern Ireland|challenged on the talk page]]. * [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Police_Service_of_Northern_Ireland&diff=prev&oldid=38233216]. Another revert war, this time over LP saying '''as fact''' that the [[Stormontgate]] spy ring was the work of [[MI5]]. As anyone with Lapsed Pacifist's knowledge of Northern Ireland affairs would surely know, responsibility for this affair is still hotly debated, with the British government flatly denying that MI5 were behind it. * [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1970_in_Ireland&action=history] — edit-warring over a period of ''six months'' in an attempt to substitute his preferred POV term "six counties" for "Northern Ireland". * [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Combat_18&action=history] — another six-month edit war, this time trying to remove any reference to Northern Ireland entirely. After extensive and fruitless attempts to resolve these issues with this user (relevant talk pages: [[Talk:Articles 2 and 3 of the Constitution of Ireland]], [[User talk:Demiurge#Unionist paramilitaries (1912 - )]], [[Talk:Demographics and politics of Northern Ireland]]), I've come to the conclusion that this user has made no serious attempt to follow [[WP:NPOV]], instead viewing talk-page discussion as a delaying tactic. [[User:Demiurge|Demiurge]] 19:35, 5 February 2006 (UTC) ==Preliminary decisions== ===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (4/0/1/0)=== * Accept. [[User:The Epopt|➥the Epopt]] 21:07, 5 February 2006 (UTC) * Accept. [[User:Dmcdevit|Dmcdevit]]·[[User talk:Dmcdevit|t]] 07:52, 6 February 2006 (UTC) * Accept. [[User:Neutrality|Neutrality]][[User talk:Neutrality|talk]] 06:24, 7 February 2006 (UTC) * Accept. [[User:Charles Matthews|Charles Matthews]] 09:23, 7 February 2006 (UTC) * Recuse. - [[User:SimonP|SimonP]] 04:20, 8 February 2006 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision= ==Principles== ===Disruptive editing=== 1) A user who disrupts Wikipedia articles by edit warring regarding use of point of view language may be banned from the affected articles, in extreme cases from the site. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC)'' == Findings of fact == ===Locus of dispute=== 1) The locus of this dispute is the edits to articles which concern the conflict in [[Northern Ireland]] and associated subjects. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC)'' ===Habitual point of view editing=== 2) {{Vandal|Lapsed_Pacifist}} has habitually engaged in point of view editing, inserting the point of view labeling language preferred by Irish Nationalists, sometimes edit warring for months, see [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Lapsed Pacifist/Evidence#Evidence presented by Fear.C3.89IREANN.5C.28caint.29]]. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC)'' ===Departure of Lapsed Pacifist=== 3) Upon acceptance of this Arbitration case, Lapsed Pacifist ceased editing Wikipedia under that user name. No clear evidence exists that he has continued to edit anonymously or under any other account. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===Lapsed Pacifist banned from affected articles=== 1) Lapsed Pacifist is banned indefinitely from articles which relate to the conflict in Northern Ireland. The ban is intended to include any page in Wikipedia which Lapsed Pacifist engages in a dispute related in any way to the conflict in Northern Ireland. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 19:17, 4 April 2006 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== {{Arbitration standard provisions}} ==Log of blocks and bans== Here log any block, ban or extension under any remedy in this decision. Minimum information includes name of administrator, date and time, what was done and the basis for doing it.[[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] * I blocked {{User|Lapsed Pacifist}} for 24hrs for a violation of remedy 1. He edited [[Black and Tans]] to add a controversial category [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Black_and_Tans&diff=prev&oldid=219164616]. I have also advised the user to be more liberal in his interpretation of the remedy. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:BigDunc&diff=prev&oldid=218933234] [[User:Rockpocket|Rockpock]]e[[User_talk:Rockpocket|t]] 17:16, 14 June 2008 (UTC) * I block {{User|Lapsed Pacifist}} for 48 hours for a second violation of the remedy, for [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Human_shield&diff=221169861&oldid=221168791 this edit] and the subsequent reversion when the content was removed. I also advised the editor that in the spirit of the ruling, it would be best to avoid any controversial edits about this topic, even in unrelated articles. [[User:Shell_Kinney|Shell]] [[User_talk:Shell_Kinney|babelfish]] 18:15, 24 June 2008 (UTC) * Blocked for a week. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Irish_Republican_Army&diff=prev&oldid=232313864] [[User:PhilKnight|PhilKnight]] ([[User talk:PhilKnight|talk]]) 16:29, 16 August 2008 (UTC) * Blocked for Two Weeks, for a fourth violation of his ArbCom topic ban. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement&oldid=318549442#Lapsed_Pacifist] [[User:SirFozzie|SirFozzie]] ([[User talk:SirFozzie|talk]]) 22:42, 7 October 2009 (UTC) * Blocked for 48 hours, in part due to violating this topic ban.[https://secure.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=331099150&oldid=331093266][https://secure.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=331104873&oldid=331101636] [[User:John Vandenberg|John Vandenberg]] '''([[User talk:John Vandenberg|chat]])''' 15:55, 11 December 2009 (UTC) *Blocked by {{user|Tiptoety}} at 19:50, 12 March 2011 , for 48 hours because of a topic ban violation. *Blocked for a month because of multiple topic ban violations, per [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement&oldid=419853993#Lapsed_Pacifist this AE request]. [[User:Sandstein|''' Sandstein ''']] 20:34, 20 March 2011 (UTC) *Blocked indefinitely per [[Wikipedia:Sockpuppet investigations/Lapsed Pacifist]]. At least on alternate account, [[User:Gestur]], violated the topic ban, thus noting it here. [[User talk:Amalthea|Amalthea]] 07:57, 8 April 2011 (UTC) {{NOINDEX}}

cases.content:
{{ArbComNav}} '''Case Opened''' on 03:01, 18 August 2009 (UTC)
'''Case Closed''' on 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC) '''Case amended by [[Special:Permalink/691438839#Motion:_Removal_of_Unused_Sanctions|motion]]''' on 21:14, 19 November 2015 (UTC)
Watchlist all case pages: [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}&action=watch '''1'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Evidence&action=watch '''2'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Workshop&action=watch '''3'''], [{{SERVER}}{{SCRIPTPATH}}/index.php?title={{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/Proposed_decision&action=watch '''4''']
Please do not edit this page directly unless you are either 1) an Arbitrator, 2) an Arbitration Clerk, or 3) adding yourself to this case. Statements on this page are original comments provided when the Committee was initially requested to Arbitrate this page (at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration|Requests for arbitration]]), and serve as opening statements; as such, they should not be altered. Any evidence you wish to provide to the Arbitrators should go on the [[/Evidence]] subpage. Arbitrators, the parties, and other editors may suggest proposed principles, findings, and remedies at [[/Workshop]]. That page may also be used for general comments on the evidence. Arbitrators will then vote on a final decision in the case at [[/Proposed decision]]. Once the case is closed, editors may add to the [[#Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions]] as needed, but this page should not be edited otherwise. Please raise any questions at [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration#Requests for clarification]], and report violations of remedies at [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard/Arbitration enforcement]]. === Involved parties === *{{userlinks|Steve Crossin}}, ''filing party'' *{{userlinks|Lapsed Pacifist}} *{{userlinks|GainLine}} *{{userlinks|Falcon9x5}} ;Confirmation that all parties are aware of the request *[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=308230304&oldid=307956251 Lapsed Pacifist notified] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:GainLine&diff=308230342&oldid=307990029 GainLine notified] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Falcon9x5&diff=308230377&oldid=307206456 Falcon9x5 notified] ;Confirmation that other steps in [[Wikipedia:dispute resolution|dispute resolution]] have been tried *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Lapsed_Pacifist RFAR 1] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requests_for_comment/Lapsed_Pacifist RFC/U 1] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard/IncidentArchive511#Vandal.2Factivist.2Fanti-Semite AN] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard/Archive_26#User:Lapsed_Pacifist COIN 1] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest/Noticeboard/Archive_32#Corrib_Gas_Articles_.26_Shell_to_Sea COIN 2] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Mediation_Cabal/Cases/2009-05-06/Corrib_Gas Mediation Cabal case] *[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&oldid=307956251#Your_COI_and_Current_Editing_relating_to_Corrib_Gas_topics Talk page request] == Statement by Steve Crossin == I first came across Lapsed Pacifist in the above mentioned MedCab case, where I offered to take the case and help them with resolving the dispute. Later on, commitments in real life led me away from the case. I asked for opening statements from all parties, where LP stated he is [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_talk:Mediation_Cabal/Cases/2009-05-06/Corrib_Gas#Statement_by_Lapsed_Pacifist involved in the Shell to Sea campaign], which is backed up by their [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3ALog&type=upload&user=Lapsed+Pacifist&page=&year=&month=-1&tagfilter=&hide_patrol_log=1 image uploads]. While this isn't normally an issue by itself, after doing some digging, I have some serious concerns, not just in this topic area, but others as well. I will keep the diffs limited, I have plenty more, but I will add more at request of the arbitrators, others I will post at /Evidence. Issues have included heavy POV pushing [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Public_Order_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=244403763][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Statoil&diff=prev&oldid=262436294][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Rossport&diff=307359621&oldid=306423898][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Cuban_Five&diff=prev&oldid=295958570][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Irgun&diff=prev&oldid=307760403][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Anglo-Soviet_invasion_of_Iran&diff=prev&oldid=297362323][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Public_Order_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=283386759][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_to_Sea&diff=prev&oldid=286474107], adding uncited material [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Willie_Corduff&diff=prev&oldid=286679655][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Willie_Corduff&curid=13901552&diff=307726684&oldid=307214727], edit warring [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Joe_Higgins&action=history][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_Exploration_and_Production_Ireland&action=history][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ray_Burke&diff=prev&oldid=288921125][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&action=history], original research [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=prev&oldid=280007183][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk%3AIntegrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=287302385&oldid=287302242], adding undue weight to articles [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=L%C3%89_Aoife_(P22)&diff=prev&oldid=261611799][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Water_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=278099445][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=County_Mayo&diff=prev&oldid=281313506][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=StatoilHydro&diff=prev&oldid=307904773][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&diff=prev&oldid=307904569], personal attacks on other editors [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_to_Sea&diff=283201969&oldid=282773895][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Falcon9x5&diff=prev&oldid=278591048] and soapboxing [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&diff=prev&oldid=262373326]. He also violated his arbitration remedy recently [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Peadar_O%27Donnell&diff=next&oldid=307363132], however no action was taken as it was stale by the time I notified an administrator. There's hundreds more diffs, but, but opening statements need to be brief. I'll keep it to this. If arbitrators need any more evidence, I'm happy to. I realise that there has not been a very recent RFC/U posted, however I feel that several attempts to resolve this dispute have been made, without result. I feel that filing another RFC would merely be process for the sake of process, and I request that you accept this case. [[User:Steve Crossin|Steve Crossin]] [[User talk:Steve Crossin|The clock is ticking....]] 02:26, 16 August 2009 (UTC) ===Proposed injunction=== I've seen that LP has continued to edit disruptively, even after notified about this case. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&limit=20&target=Lapsed+Pacifist]. Might I suggest a temporary injunction? 1) {{User|Lapsed Pacifist}} is topic banned from articles related to Corrib Gas, broadly defined, for the duration of this arbitration case. Any uninvolved administrator may issue blocks, starting at 24 hours and escalating after each violation. Thoughts? [[User:Steve Crossin|Steve Crossin]] [[User talk:Steve Crossin|The clock is ticking....]] 01:08, 17 August 2009 (UTC) == Statement by GainLine == I first came across Lapsed Pacifist on the [[Shell to Sea]] (S2S) which read like a propaganda piece. Their COI declared on their userpage was only done so well after being challenged in this thread [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Garda_Síochána#Extrajudicial_punishment], since challenged on COIN. Cited reason for ignoring this as policy interpretation.[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Integrated_Risk_Management_Services]. They also show prejudice towards the subjects they edit on. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk%3AIntegrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=287302385&oldid=287302242] *''' Involvement with the campaign''' LPs involvement with the campaign is evidenced with images uploaded as being their own work. Images appearing on wikipedia. Eg. [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:2008_0909maura_hunger_strike0018.jpg] & [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Iollan%27s_%22arrest%22.jpg]appear on S2S website [http://www.corribsos.com/index.php?id=1984] & [[Indymedia]]: [http://www.indymedia.ie/article/91493]. * '''POV Pushing''' LP uses Wikipedia as a platform to promote their political ideals through heavy POV pushing; inserting soapboxing claims then edit warring aggressively eg. straight reverts for no other reason than they "disagree" [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Marathon_Oil&diff=prev&oldid=280865255], reverts with personal attacks [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Willie_Corduff&diff=prev&oldid=307904692] &/or antagonistic edit summaries [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Public_Order_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=281927523]. This is coupled with frustration on talk pages. LP is incapable of editing with NPOV. Steve has provided plenty of examples but there are hundreds available & LP has a long history. Language is used in a subtly negative manner as it was in NI articles. The police force of the ROI is [[Garda Siochana]] however LP frequently refers to them as police [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=prev&oldid=307365829], not too bad on a talk page but perjorative in an article. Multiple negative images in articles edited by LP. Articles created to attack subjects [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Policing_of_the_Corrib_gas_protests&diff=278332050&oldid=278331571] . Undue weight in others [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Water_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=278302701], or creating topics pointing to S2S [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=No-arrest_policy&diff=prev&oldid=279184418]. *'''Etiquette''' Personal attacks are common: [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ray_Burke&diff=prev&oldid=288921125], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&diff=prev&oldid=307193993] ,[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Biographies_of_living_persons/Noticeboard&diff=next&oldid=288054684#Mary_Devins], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=next&oldid=279563867]. There is no will for dispute resolution and are now ignoring my request to stop editing on S2S topics.[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Contributions/Lapsed_Pacifist] . Comments on the users page suggests they believe past actions taken against them were somehow unjustified. While I'm not involved I've noticed similar behaviour in other areas such as the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. : The user is part of a campaign which is involved in civil disobedience so it should come as no surprise that when campaigning here they frequently ignore requests to adhere to policy: [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Shell_to_Sea#Citation_requests], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Public_Order_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=244403763]. This shows contempt towards the project & its community. Their userpage is practically a political statement & wikipedia is being used as a platform to further this. [[User:GainLine|'''G'''ain'''Line ''']] [[Special:Contributions/GainLine|♠]] [[User talk:GainLine|♥]] 21:52, 16 August 2009 (UTC) == Statement by Falcon9x5 == Most of the actual evidence has been aptly covered by GainLine and Steve above, so I'll keep this fairly short.
I first encountered LP back in September 2008, when after editing the [[Shell to Sea]] article to remove [[WP:POV]], they (not sure of gender, so I'll stick to third-person plural) made [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_to_Sea&diff=240400987&oldid=239774660 this revert]. Despite acknowledging several times to be involved in the Shell to Sea campaign (covered above), and [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Falcon9x5&diff=240397553&oldid=240165152 being aware of the COI policy] LP believes this not to be an issue and edits related articles, inserting heavy POV with impunity. There's many examples noted above, [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_to_Sea&diff=279800631&oldid=279799390 this] one I feel aptly shows LP's strong bias.
Again, as noted above, this bias extends to other topics, mainly US and Israeli (where LP is negative) and left-wing/socialist (where LP is positive). Two diffs that cover this bias quite well are [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Cuban_Five&diff=prev&oldid=295958570 this edit] to a [[Cuban Five|Cuban spy group article]], where the word "murdered" was changed to "killed", and [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Irgun&diff=prev&oldid=307760403 this edit] to a [[Irgun|Jewish/Israeli paramilitary group]] where the word "killed" was changed to "blown up".
Yet again as noted above, while perhaps not outright [[WP:NPA|personal attacks]], LP often makes [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Rossport&diff=prev&oldid=308383340 antagonistic] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Willie_Corduff&diff=prev&oldid=307904692 edit] summaries and the occasional (what I'd consider to be) [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Falcon9x5&diff=278591048&oldid=278587775 massively sarcastic] or [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=287302385&oldid=287302242 massively POV] comment on talk pages.
Finally, that LP's [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Likud&diff=prev&oldid=308375865 POV] and [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=LÉ_Orla_(P41)&diff=prev&oldid=308380489 UNDUE] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Israel_Defense_Forces_checkpoint&diff=prev&oldid=308373355 editing] has continued despite being made aware of this RFAR says to me they are unable to see the POV, biased, nature of their edits.
There's more of course, constant non-[[WP:NPOV]], the occasional [[WP:PA]], constant [[WP:SOAPBOX]]ing, constant [[WP:UNDUE]], constant [[WP:WEASEL]], but I think they've all be covered pretty well already. LP appears to be aware of said policies and guidelines, and apparently [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Shell_to_Sea&diff=279804485&oldid=279801695 believes they abides by them ("I don't ignore any policies")].
Hope all that provides a strong case for the need for arbitration! Thanks! [[User:Falcon9x5|Fin]][[Special:Contributions/Falcon9x5|©]][[User talk:Falcon9x5|™]] 11:39, 17 August 2009 (UTC) === Clerk notes === :''This area is used for notes by non-recused Clerks.'' *I'm not sure if the Arbs have noticed, but Steve has proposed a temporary injunction that would topic-ban Lapsed Pacifist. This has reached net four, though, so this technically can be opened in two hours (once we find a clerk). [[User:Hersfold|'''''Hersfold''''']] ([[User:Hersfold/t|t]]/[[User:Hersfold/a|a]]/[[Special:Contributions/Hersfold|c]]) 00:09, 18 August 2009 (UTC) === Arbitrators' opinion on hearing this matter (6/0/0/1) === *'''Comment''' leaning ''accept'' on the basis of: (1) a previous [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Lapsed Pacifist|arbitration case]] which I note had no specifications of time in it. Many remedies are maxed at a one year duration and I think reviewing conduct since that case is prudent, (2) claims on Lapsed Pacifist's userpage regarding action being taken against him by involved admins - this should be examined and either refuted or investigated, (3) contentious topic area editing may obfuscate an RfC as editors might comment along ideological lines. I will await other comments but I suspect this one needs some investigating. [[User:Casliber|Casliber]] ([[User talk:Casliber|talk]] '''·''' [[Special:Contributions/Casliber|contribs]]) 03:10, 16 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept''' numerous long term patterns of behavior and unsuccessful attempts at resolution. — [[User:Rlevse|Rlevse]] • [[User_talk:Rlevse|Talk]] • 17:43, 16 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept''' [[User:Wizardman|'''''Wizardman''''']] 00:49, 17 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''; I see long term — and indeed ''ongoing'' — behavioral issues that need to be examined. — [[User:Coren|Coren]] [[User Talk:Coren|(talk)]] 03:14, 17 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. [[User:Risker|Risker]] ([[User talk:Risker|talk]]) 06:21, 17 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. [[User:Newyorkbrad|Newyorkbrad]] ([[User talk:Newyorkbrad|talk]]) 15:47, 17 August 2009 (UTC) *'''Accept'''. Lapsed Pacifist has continued editing since being notified, and seems to have chosen not to enter a statement. I would encourage a statement to be entered, but on the basis of what I've seen so far, accept a case to examine conduct issues here. [[User:Carcharoth|Carcharoth]] ([[User talk:Carcharoth|talk]]) 00:03, 18 August 2009 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction=== ===Lapsed Pacifist topic banned=== 1) For the duration of this case, {{userlinks|Lapsed Pacifist}} is topic banned from articles related to Corrib Gas, broadly defined. Any uninvolved administrator may issue blocks up to 24 hours in duration for violations of this injunction. Attempts to game the injunction may also be taken into consideration. :''Passed 4 to 0 at 21:47, 22 August 2009 (UTC)'' =Final decision= ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]], where vote counts and comments are also available.'' ==Principles== ===Purpose of Wikipedia=== 1) The purpose of Wikipedia is to create a high-quality, free-content encyclopedia in an atmosphere of camaraderie and mutual respect among contributors. Use of the site for [[Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not|other purposes]], such as [[Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not#Wikipedia is not a soapbox|soapboxing, advocacy or propaganda]], [[Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not#Wikipedia is not a battleground|furtherance of outside conflicts]], publishing or promoting [[Wikipedia:No original research|original research]], and political or ideological struggle, is prohibited. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Editorial conduct=== 2) Wikipedia users are expected to behave reasonably, calmly, and courteously in their interactions with other users; to approach even difficult situations in a dignified fashion and with a constructive and collaborative outlook; and to avoid acting in a manner that brings the project into disrepute. Unseemly conduct, such as [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks|personal attacks]], [[Wikipedia:Civility|incivility]], [[Wikipedia:Assume good faith|assumptions of bad faith]], [[Wikipedia:Trolling|trolling]], [[Wikipedia:Harassment|harassment]], [[Wikipedia:Do not disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point|disruptive point-making]], and [[Wikipedia:Gaming the system|gaming the system]], is prohibited. Concerns regarding the actions of other users should be brought up in the [[Wikipedia:Dispute resolution|appropriate forums]]. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Neutral point of view=== 3) Wikipedia adopts a [[Wikipedia:NPOV|neutral point of view]], and [[Wikipedia:What Wikipedia is not#Wikipedia is not a soapbox|advocacy]] for any particular viewpoint is prohibited. NPOV is a [[m:Foundation issues|non-negotiable, fundamental policy]], and requires that editors strive to (a) ensure articles accurately reflect all significant viewpoints that have been published by reliable sources and (b) ensure that viewpoints are not given [[WP:UNDUE|undue weight]], and are kept in proportion with the weight of the source. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Conflicts of interest=== 4) An editor has a conflict of interest when their interests in editing Wikipedia, or the interests of those they represent, conflict or potentially conflict with the interests of the Wikipedia project in producing a neutral, verifiable encyclopaedia. An editor will have a conflict of interest with respect to an article if, for example, they have a significant financial interest in the subject, they are involved with the subject of the article in a significant capacity, or if the article is about them or about a business or organisation that they represent. :''Passed 6 to 1 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Wikipedia is not a soapbox=== 5) Wikipedia is not a soapbox for propaganda or activist editing, including, but not limited to, creating articles to promote a particular point of view on a certain topic. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Sourcing of articles=== 6) Wikipedia articles rely mainly on reliable mainstream [[Wikipedia:SECONDARY|secondary sources]] as these provide the requisite analysis, interpretation and context. Academic and peer-reviewed publications are the most highly valued sources and are usually the most reliable. [[Wikipedia:SELFPUB|Self-published works]], whether by an individual or an organisation, may only be used in limited circumstances and with extreme care. Primary sources may be used to support specific statements of fact limited to descriptive aspects of these primary sources. In the event of sourcing disputes, talk page discussion should be used to discuss the dispute and seek a resolution. If discussion there does not resolve the dispute, the [[Wikipedia:Reliable sources/Noticeboard|Reliable sources]] or Content Noticeboard should be used. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Edit warring=== 7) Edit-warring, whether by [[Wikipedia:Reversion|reversion]] or otherwise, is prohibited; this is so even when the disputed content is clearly problematic, with [[Wikipedia:Three-revert rule#Exceptions|very limited exceptions]]. The [[Wikipedia:Three-revert rule|three-revert rule]] does not entitle users to revert a page three times each day, nor does it endorse reverting as an editing technique. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Biographies of living persons=== 8) Wikipedia articles that present material about living people can affect their subjects' lives. Wikipedia editors who deal with these articles have a responsibility to consider the legal and ethical implications of their actions when doing so. Adding unreliable, unsourced, or unduly weighted negative material or vandalising these pages displays particularly poor conduct. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ==Findings of fact== ===Lapsed Pacifist in arbitration=== 1) Rulings regarding Lapsed Pacifist's conduct were previously made in ''[[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Lapsed Pacifist]]'' (closed April 2006), where he was found to have "habitually engaged in point of view editing, inserting the point of view labeling language preferred by Irish Nationalists, sometimes edit warring for months", and was "banned indefinitely from articles which relate to the conflict in Northern Ireland." He subsequently retired in February 2006, for a period before returning to editing in May 2007. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist's declaration of POV and COI=== 2) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} has declared he has a Point of View and Conflict of Interest in articles related to the Corrib gas controversy and Shell to sea campaign.[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk:Mediation_Cabal/Cases/2009-05-06/Corrib_Gas&diff=289860149&oldid=288775176] :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist has edit warred=== 3) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} has edit warred, both within articles related to the [[Corrib gas controversy]] - [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:Joe_Higgins&action=history][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shell_Exploration_and_Production_Ireland&action=history][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ray_Burke&diff=prev&oldid=288921125], and elsewhere - [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&action=history][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Rush_Limbaugh&action=history]. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist has used unclear edit summaries=== 4) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} has used unclear edit summaries. This has proven problematic when done in volatile editing situations and is not conducive to a calm and courteous environment. These have included [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=279636982&oldid=279592385 So?], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=308380907&oldid=308028343 I disagree], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Rush_Limbaugh&diff=314332856&oldid=314174293 I strongly disagree], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=StatoilHydro&diff=307904773&oldid=307730858 Undo whitewashing (when an editor removed material of undue weight], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&diff=prev&oldid=307725174 Undo whitewashing (again)], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Israeli_West_Bank_barrier&diff=prev&oldid=307760936 So? (again, when an editor removed content that wasn't backed up by sources], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Reagan_Doctrine&diff=prev&oldid=293093965 Nonsense], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Integrated_Risk_Management_Services&diff=279564416&oldid=279563867], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Corrib_gas_project&diff=281929007&oldid=280001999], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=StatoilHydro&curid=11866976&diff=309086436&oldid=308883066] :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist's editing has led to article imbalance and undue weight issues=== 5) Some edits of {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} have led to issues of undue weight within articles [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=L%C3%89_Aoife_(P22)&diff=prev&oldid=261611799][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Garda_Water_Unit&diff=prev&oldid=278099445][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=County_Mayo&diff=prev&oldid=281313506][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=StatoilHydro&diff=prev&oldid=307904773][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Glengad&diff=prev&oldid=307904569] :''Passed 7 to 0 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine has used two or more accounts abusively=== 8) Early in his wikipedia career, {{user|GainLine}} edited as {{user|Mustycrusty}} and {{user|Greenlightgo}} :''Passed 7 to 0 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine has vandalised a BLP=== 9) {{user|GainLine}}, as {{user|Mustycrusty}} committed BLP violations. :''Passed 7 to 0 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine's later conduct=== 10) To his credit, Gainline appears to have desisted from the above earlier indiscretions in subsequent editing. :''Passed 7 to 0 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===All articles related to [[Corrib gas controversy]] and [[Shell to Sea]]=== 1) All articles related to [[Corrib gas controversy]] and the [[Shell to Sea]] campaign are placed under probation. All fall under 1RR, and a stricter rather than laxer interpretation of addition of and removal unsourced content. Where content or its phrasing is disputed, editors are directed to seek outside opinion at the [[Wikipedia:Content noticeboard|Content]], [[Wikipedia:Reliable sources/Noticeboard|Reliable Sources]], [[Wikipedia:Neutral point of view/Noticeboard|Neutral point of view]] or [[Wikipedia:Third opinion|Third Opinion]] Noticeboards, and abide by the consensus achieved thereafter. :''Passed 6 to 1 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ::''Rescinded by [[#Removal of Unused Sanctions (November 2015)|motion]] at 21:14, 19 November 2015 (UTC)'' ===All editors reminded=== 2) An alternative method of dealing with undue weight in small or underdeveloped articles is to evenly expand an article so that the material in question does not take up an undue percentage of space. Not only is this more in line with the objectives of Wikipedia (adding rather than removing content), but it is less likely to antagonise other editors (Wikipedia is not a battleground). :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist admonished and reminded to be especially careful=== 3) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} is admonished for edit warring, both in the [[Corrib gas project]] and elsewhere, and is reminded to be especially careful when editing in an area where one has a [[WP:COI|conflict of interest]] or strong point of view. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ====Lapsed Pacifist topic banned==== 3.1) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} is topic banned, indefinitely, from articles related to the [[Corrib gas project]], broadly defined. Any administrator may, after warning, extend this topic ban to other topic areas, in the event of further problematic editing. :''Passed 6 to 1, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist encouraged=== 4) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} is encouraged to use succinct and accurate edit summaries when editing in areas that could be construed as volatile or having the potential to be volatile, such as most political articles and those concerning some form of conflict. The editor is also encouraged to comment on edits rather than editors. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===Lapsed Pacifist restricted=== 5) {{user|Lapsed Pacifist}} is subject to an editing restriction for one year, namely is limited to one revert per page per week (except for undisputable vandalism and BLP violations), and is required to discuss any content reversions on the page's talk page. Should Lapsed Pacifist exceed this limit or fail to discuss a content reversion, he may be blocked for the duration specified in the enforcement ruling below. :''Passed 8 to 0, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine strongly admonished=== 7) {{user|GainLine}} is strongly admonished for vandalising BLPs. :''Passed 4 to 1 with 3 abstentions, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine admonished=== 8) {{user|GainLine}} is admonished for sockpuppetry. :''Passed 6 to 1 with 1 abstention, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ===GainLine commended and encouraged=== 9) {{user|GainLine}} is commended for desisting from early problematic behaviours and encouraged to pursue appropriate [[WP:DR|dispute resolution]] methods, and seek [[WP:A|administrator intervention]] when required. :''Passed 6 to 0 with 2 abstentions, 08:48, 12 October 2009 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== {{Arbitration standard provisions}} ==Amendments== ===Removal of Unused Sanctions (November 2015)=== {{Ivmbox|1=Every so often, it becomes reasonable to terminate sanctions that are no longer necessary, # Remedy 1 of the [[w:wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Lapsed Pacifist 2|Lapsed Pacifist 2 case]] is rescinded; # Remedy 2 of the [[w:Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Mantanmoreland|Mantanmoreland case]] is rescinded; # Remedy 1 of the [[w:Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Waterboarding|Waterboarding case]] is rescinded; # Remedy 1 of the [[w:Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Vivaldi|Vivaldi case]] is rescinded; # Nothing in this motion provides grounds for appeal of remedies or restrictions imposed while article probations for the foregoing cases were in force. Such appeals or requests to lift or modify such sanctions may be made under the same terms as any other appeal; #In the event that disruptive editing resumes in any of these topic-areas, a request to consider reinstating discretionary sanctions in that topic-area may be made on the clarifications and amendments page.}} :''Passed 8 to 2 with 2 abstentions by [[Special:Permalink/691438839#Motion:_Removal_of_Unused_Sanctions|motion]] at 21:14, 19 November 2015 (UTC)'' ==Log of blocks, bans, and restrictions== Log any block, restriction, ban or extension under any remedy in this decision here. Minimum information includes name of administrator, date and time, what was done and the basis for doing it. *06:43, 18 November 2009 (UTC) Following violation of [[#Lapsed_Pacifist_restricted|remedy 5 (revert and discuss)]] by [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Boston_Massacre&diff=prev&oldid=326194982 reverting] on [[Boston Massacre]] and ignoring a [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=prev&oldid=326260493 request] to discuss as required. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=326492087&oldid=326260493 Block notice][http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement&diff=326492290&oldid=326491175 AE notice].--[[User:Tznkai|Tznkai]] ([[User talk:Tznkai|talk]]) 03:07, 20 November 2009 (UTC) *02:50, 20 November 2009 (UTC) Following violation of [[#Lapsed_Pacifist_topic_banned_2|remedy 3.1 (topic ban)]] by [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Centre_for_Public_Inquiry&diff=prev&oldid=326823155 editing] [[Centre for Public Inquiry]]. [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk%3ALapsed_Pacifist&action=historysubmit&diff=326859418&oldid=326739452 block notice], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement&diff=prev&oldid=326858426 AE notice].--[[User:Tznkai|Tznkai]] ([[User talk:Tznkai|talk]]) 03:07, 20 November 2009 (UTC) * Blocked for 48 hours, in part due to violating the topic ban of the first case, and in part for not heeding the advice in this case.[https://secure.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=331099150&oldid=331093266][https://secure.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=331104873&oldid=331101636][https://secure.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Lapsed_Pacifist&diff=331104873&oldid=331101636 AE] [[User:John Vandenberg|John Vandenberg]] '''([[User talk:John Vandenberg|chat]])''' 15:58, 11 December 2009 (UTC) *{{User|Lapsed Pacifist}} has been blocked for 48 hours for violating the above topic ban after they edited [[Centre for Public Inquiry]]. cases.content:
<big>'''Case Opened''' on May 1, 2005</big>  

<big>'''Case Closed''' on 22:24, 2 Jun 2005 (UTC)</big>  

Please do not edit this page directly unless you wish to become a participant in this request. (All participants are subject to Arbitration Committee decisions, and the ArbCom will consider each participant's role in the dispute.) Comments are very welcome on the [[Wikipedia talk:{{PAGENAME}}|Talk page]], and will be read, in full. Evidence, no matter who can provide it, is very welcome at [[/Evidence]]. Evidence is more useful than comments. 

Arbitrators will be working on a proposed decision at [[/Proposed decision]]. 

==Involved parties==
<!--provide links to the user page of each party and to all accounts they have edited with. Briefly summarize case. No details. -->

* [[User:LevelCheck]]

==Statement by party 1==
Please limit your statement to 500 words

I feel LevelCheck has been editing in bad faith. [[User:LevelCheck]] has, since he/she arrived at Wikipedia, disrupted its function, in ways which I do not believe to have been in good faith, violating the policy at [[WP:POINT]]. The pattern began with his nomination of [[User:SamuraiClinton]] for adminship [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_adminship/SamuraiClinton&oldid=12365923 ]. This was a nomination which would almost certainly fail, as SamuraiClinton at the time was involved in a dispute over neologism-writing and other behaviors (since straightened out). It would be obvious to any good faith editor that this was an inappropriate nomination. User originally made this nomination anonymously, only registering when the nomination was almost removed due to being made by an anon. The user was warned on their talk page.

Nevertheless, disruption of Wikipedia continued--the user continued to make edits that could not conceivably be in good faith. For example, [[Poking dogs with sticks]] was created as a redirect to [[animal cruelty]]--when I enquired about it, the user replied saying "The redirect seemed like a good idea at the time. Go ahead and delete it if you want" [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Meelar&diff=12465612&oldid=12454466].   The user also engaged in other disruption, including creating the article [[Worst United States President in history]] and then violating the 3-revert rule on it. New users might mistakenly create such an article, but I maintain that someone familiar with WP policies, which this user certainly seems to be, would not create such a page (it's now on Vfd, with a vote running 31 to 0 in favor of deletion). 

I was finally moved to file this RFC after this user created [[:Category:Phony Texan Warmongers]], stocking it with [[Tom DeLay]] and [[George W. Bush]]; he also created [[:Category:Islamophobes]] and added it to [[Christopher Hitchens]] and [[Daniel Pipes]]. After the category was removed on DeLay, LevelCheck reinserted it, saying that "The category does exist. If you'd like, I'd be open to renaming it "Alleged Phony Texan Warmongers". Otherwise, your remedy is to list it on WP:CFD" [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tom_DeLay&diff=12676662&oldid=12676594].  Again, this just shows familiarity with WP policies, which he/she has willfully chosen to break in submitting this obviously bogus category.

In the RfC, the user addressed the issue of what he/she referred to as "Socratic editing", claiming that the creation of the bogus categories and the nomination of SamuraiClinton were intended to "force us to defend and explicate what we believe, rather than take it for granted" [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_comment/LevelCheck&diff=12751410&oldid=12735279]. The statement did not address the larger issue of disruptive editing, editing designed to get a rise. I mistakenly assumed, however, that the user was showing contrition and would be more helpful in the future. 

Regrettably, the disruptive editing did not cease. For example, the user asked on [[User talk:Viriditas]] "How long have you been a fascist?" [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk%3AViriditas&diff=12778121&oldid=12777888]. This was followed by a warning on his talk page to avoid further disruptive editing. Hours after this warning, LevelCheck created the article [[Izziehugger]]. That article is currently on Vfd, where the votes are running 9-0 in favor of deletion. "Izziehugger" is an obscure political epithet created on Usenet--it receives 25 google hits, according to LevelCheck, who noted this fact in the article. I believe that in noting the extreme obscurity of this entry, LevelCheck signifies that the artice was not created in good fath--as [[User:Postdlf|Postdlf]] noted on the vfd, "No reasonable Wikipedian would have created this."  Indeed, LevelCheck appears to be editing in bad faith.

I tried to [[Wikipedia:Assume good faith|assume good faith]] in this case, but a consistent pattern of disruptive editing has made it impossible.  LevelCheck appears to be editing not for the good of the encyclopedia, but solely to provoke people. Not all of his/her edits have been controversial (for example, he/she has tagged many articles for speedy deletion which were quite worthy).  But the bad-faith edits are simply too numerous for these to be innocent mistakes. I submit that this user is disrupting Wikipedia for some reason, be it their own entertainment, "Socratic" editing, or what-have-you, and request succour from the Arbitration committee.

[[User:Meelar|Meelar]] [[User talk:Meelar|(talk)]] 23:41, Apr 26, 2005 (UTC)

Update: Well after this request was submitted and arbitrators had questioned his  behavior, LevelCheck edited [[Jumbo shrimp]]. It had been a redirect to [[shrimp]], and he changed it to a redirect to [[oxymoron]]. I'm not sure where to request an injunction banning him from editing non-arb-case pages, but consider this my request. [[User:Meelar|Meelar]] [[User talk:Meelar|(talk)]] 02:14, Apr 27, 2005 (UTC)


==Statement by party 2==
Please limit your statement to 500 words

No comment. [[User:LevelCheck|LevelCheck]] 21:27, 26 Apr 2005 (UTC)

<!--Add additional statements if necessary, for each directly involved user. Comments by users outside the dispute go on the talk page.-->

==Preliminary decisions==
===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (5/0/0/0)===
*'''Accept''', though I seriously wonder if this this user is a sockpuppet. [[User:Ambi|Ambi]] 22:45, 26 Apr 2005 (UTC)
*'''Accept'''. Ambi's question on socks was enough for me to go look, 'cos it smelt that way to me too, but there's no IP matches in the past week. There's been a pile of good edits, but the behaviour in the complaint is certainly problematic enough - [[User:David Gerard|David Gerard]] 23:38, 26 Apr 2005 (UTC)
*'''Accept'''. This is extremely eccentric behaviour and I would like to see what circumstances might be responsible for it. --[[User:Grunt|Grun]][[User talk:Grunt|t]] [[European Union|🇪🇺]] 00:44, 2005 Apr 27 (UTC)
*'''Accept'''. [[User:The Epopt|➥the Epopt]] 15:33, 27 Apr 2005 (UTC)
*'''Accept'''. [[User:Neutrality|Neutrality]]<sup>[[User talk:Neutrality|talk]]</sup> 03:04, May 1, 2005 (UTC)

===Temporary injunction===
1) For demonstrated disruptive editing habits, LevelCheck is prohibited from editing outside his userspace and pages related to this case for the duration of the case.

:''Passed 4 to 0 at 23:58, 18 May 2005 (UTC)''

=Final decision =
''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]]'' (vote counts and comments are there as well)
==Principles==

===Don't disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point===
1) [[Wikipedia:Don't disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point|Don't disrupt Wikipedia to illustrate a point]].


:''Passed 6 to 0 at 22:24, 2 Jun 2005 (UTC)'' 

===Sockpuppetry===
2) The ''use'' of [[Wikipedia:Sockpuppet|sockpuppet]] accounts, while not generally forbidden, is discouraged. ''Abuse'' of sockpuppet accounts, such as using them to evade blocks and bans, make personal attacks or reverts, or vandalize, is strictly forbidden. 

:''Passed 6 to 0 at 22:24, 2 Jun 2005 (UTC)'' 

==Findings of Fact==

1) Most, if not all, of [[User:LevelCheck|LevelCheck]]'s contributions have been edits that are widely considered to be disruptive. See the evidence page for diffs.

:''Passed 6 to 0 at 22:24, 2 Jun 2005 (UTC)'' 

===Potential sockpuppet?===
2) [[User:LevelCheck|LevelCheck]]'s inherent familiarity with Wikipedia procedures and policies suggest that the account does not belong to an entirely new user and may indeed be a [[wikipedia:sockpuppet|sockpuppet]] account.

:''Passed 6 to 0 at 22:24, 2 Jun 2005 (UTC)'' 

==Remedies==
''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.''

===Indefinite block===
1) The account [[User:LevelCheck|LevelCheck]] is blocked indefinitely as a disruptive potential sockpuppet. Should any other accounts demonstrate similar disruptive editing habits to [[User:LevelCheck|LevelCheck]] they may also be blocked indefinitely.
