cases.content:
See also: [[Wikipedia:Requests for comment/Wik]], 

'''Case closed'''

This Arbitration involved accusations against [[User:Wik]] levied by a number of other Wikipedians. Voting on proposals can be found at the bottom of this page, with a summary of the decision, reached on 9 May 2004, at [[/Decided]]. For the evidence, see [[/Evidence]]. Some matters were not fully decided when events overtook the discussion, and Wik left.

==Summary of complaint==
Complaint (summarized): The [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wik|prior arbitration ruling]] has "added a time delay between reverts." However, Wik fails to "calmly discuss matters on the talk page and seek compromises," has an "inability to discuss with his opponents," and sometimes "unilaterally declares some version of an article [[Wikipedia:NPOV|NPOV]]" and defends it by reversion.

The following users have requested the arbitration committee review the case of Wik based on later behavior:
* [[User:Jor|— Jor ]][[User talk:Jor|(Talk)]] 19:31, 30 Mar 2004 (UTC)
* [[User:Eloquence|Eloquence]][[User:Eloquence/CP|*]] 11:41, Apr 7, 2004 (UTC)
* [[User:Kosebamse|Kosebamse]] 13:38, 7 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* [[User:Meelar|Meelar]] 17:32, 9 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* [[User:UninvitedCompany|UninvitedCompany]] 01:04, 10 Apr 2004 (UTC).  I was particularly discouraged that Wik reverted my attempt at a compromise at [[Sealand]] without comment.
* [[User:Cantus|Cantus]] 22:03, 15 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* [[User:Daeron|Daeron]] 08:13, 25 Apr 2004 (UTC)

* Additionally, [[User:Perl|Perl]] and [[User:Jor|Jor]] claim that Wik has made [[defamation|defamatory]] statements, and [[User:Kosebamse|Kosebamse]], [[User:Jor|Jor]] and [[User:Cantus|Cantus]] claim that he is rude and makes [[ad hominem]] attacks.

* Wik vandalizes User pages constantly. [[User:Cantus|Cantus]]

* Abuse of sock puppets [[User:Augustin]] and [[User:Augustine]] alleged by  [[User:RickK|RickK]] and [[User:Cantus|Cantus]]

----
On [[May 23]], Wik went on a vandalism spree, even though he had been banned for seven days beginning with [[May 20]].  First using the account of [[User:(Wik]]), then a variety of anonymous IDs, he first began making edits to his own Talk page, then to the Request for Comments page, and then, when he was blocked from editing and his Talk page protected because he was not allowed to make edits, he began vandalizing my Talk page.  I unblocked him and reverted his block to 7 days beginning on May 23 because he has not lived up to the requirements of his blocking.  [[User:RickK|Rick]]'''[[User talk:RickK|K]]''' 03:03, 24 May 2004 (UTC)

:Do you know for a fact that it was Wik? I'd like to see some evidence of that before he is accused. Then we can talk about why the anonymous user went on a "vandalism spree." Then we can talk about how you reverted the page four times in 5 minutes to your own version, and then we can discuss whether you can use your sysop powers to protect a page in which you are involved in an edit war. I'd be happy if you start by proving that it was Wik. [[User:Danny|Danny]] 03:07, 24 May 2004 (UTC)
::What?!  I'm not allowed to revert vandalism to my own Talk page!?  Now that is twisted logic!  [[User:RickK|Rick]]'''[[User talk:RickK|K]]''' 03:11, 24 May 2004 (UTC)
:::I think he's referring to your reversion and protection of [[User talk:Wik]].  I don't know what the policy is on multiple reverts and/or protection to enforce a ban; it may differ from usual reversion/protection policy.  [[User:VeryVerily|V]][[User talk:VeryVerily|V]] 03:55, 24 May 2004 (UTC)

user:(Wik) is a known and admitted sock puppet of Wik, so I believe that Danny's request for proof has already been met.

As Wik appears to have actually left (as far as I can tell), I don't believe there's anything to be gained from formally investigating this. People will look at Wik's behaviour and come to their own judgements on the matter. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 00:16, 13 Jun 2004 (UTC)

== Statement by Wik ==

[[user:Wik|Wik]]'s response (summarised):

# I made my view clear in all disputes and answered all questions. I just don't like to repeat myself, so if people repeat an argument that I've previously replied to, I don't feel obliged to copy-and-paste my previous reply.
# I am perfectly willing to compromise on subjective questions, but there is no compromise between correct and incorrect, or NPOV and POV, versions.
# Any reversion war necessarily has two sides doing the exact same number of reverts, plus/minus one. There is no way I can be blamed unilaterally for this.
# You will not get me to play along with trolls and POV pushers. If you succeed in getting me banned or prohibiting me from reverting which I'd consider equivalent, then I'll simply be off.
# If "defamatory statements" are seriously considered, I want to complain myself (just as an example) about user Ed Poor, who called me a "pest" [http://mail.wikipedia.org/pipermail/wikien-l/2004-February/010725.html], which is no less insulting than whatever I may be accused of in this regard. He may consider it a factual statement, just as I consider my statements factual.
# Additionally I want to ask for a ban of [[User:Cantus]] who behaves in an utterly inacceptable way by violating the three-revert rule (see for example [[shnorrer]]), then additionally calling in sockpuppets ([[User:Augusta]]), engaging in revenge reversion of pages he otherwise has no interest in (even in the case of a clear vandalism I had reverted on [[Ethics]], he reverted it back to the vandalized version), and spamming my talk page. Most likely [[User:Wik is Banned]] was also his sockpuppet, who did [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=User:Wik&diff=2808406&oldid=2808394 this vandalism].

=== Response by Cantus ===

I am NOT Augusta and have NEVER used Augusta as a sockpuppet or as a user in Wikipedia. Admins who can see who's who, please come forward. --[[User:Cantus|Cantus]] 21:54, 15 Apr 2004 (UTC)

== arbitrator's opinions on hearing this matter ==
'''If you are not an arbitrator do not edit below this point'''

* Support. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 17:26, Apr 9, 2004 (UTC)
* Support - a one month review makes sense, either way. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 17:28, 9 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* Support - there's a clear desire for us to have another look at this. -- [[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 17:40, 9 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* Support [[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 01:22, 10 Apr 2004 (UTC)
* Support (just piling on) --[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 22:08, 20 Apr 2004 (UTC)

==Discussion by arbitrators==
I have looked at the history of the [[antinomy]] article and the edit war Wik engaged in over the wording and placement of the phrasing of the language over confusion of [[antinomy]] with [[antimony]]. Wik's reasoning was that such information should not be within the article, but in a note at the bottom. Whether there is or ought to be such a convention I am not sure. At any rate, assisted in this nonsense by Anthony, he engaged in an edit war, desisting only when [[User:Angela]] happened to agree with him. No discussion on the article talk page. Insight into his point was obtained only by looking at a comment on his user page under "articles needing daily reversion". [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 21:28, Apr 18, 2004 (UTC)

I note on his user page he has a watchlist of 10,000 articles. This is a symptom of his combative stance. Perhaps we could limit his watchlist, if encouraging a less confrontive stance doesn't work. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 21:28, Apr 18, 2004 (UTC)

I wonder what our actual policy is regarding communicating about or justifying reversion. "[A revert] is not the advised action when dealing with edits that were made in good faith - indeed, we strongly recommend against it." ([[Wikipedia:How to revert a page to an earlier version]]) Further recommending, 'Instead, have a look at our advice on ''[[Wikipedia:staying cool when the editing gets hot|staying cool when the editing gets hot]]''.' There, the first tip is "If someone disagrees with you, try to understand why, and in your discussion on the Talk pages take the time to provide good reasons why your way is better." So we have a "strong recommendation" against using reversion in the case of edits made in good faith and a "tip" that providing good reasons for your edit on the articles talk page may help avoid disputes.

Perhaps we should look to our dispute resolution policy. Redirected from [[Wikipedia:Edit wars in progress]] looking at [[Wikipedia:Dispute resolution]] it contains in the first paragraph the following request, "Please do not engage in [[Wikipedia:Edit war|edit wars]] with other users; this is not a helpful method of [[dispute resolution]] and does nothing to improve Wikipedia. Instead, follow the process outlined here to resolve disagreements and prevent them from turning into serious disputes." After suggestions that users avoid conflict, be respectful and edit from a NPOV, there is the following explicit language: "The first resort in resolving almost any conflict is to discuss the issue on a [[Wikipedia:talk page|talk page]]. Either contact the other party on that user's talk page, or use the talk page associated with the article in question."

There is more, but I think this points at a solution to the problem presented in the instant case (this case): We should make a finding that Wik has not followed the Wikpedia policy for dispute resolution and in our decree require that he do so in the future. Addressing his aggressive editing, should he continue to engage in it, we should require that he clearly communicate on either the talk page of the article or on the user page of the other editor his reasoning or the basis for his reversion or other aggressive change. He raises the issue of only having to do this once, which has some reason, but I think requiring periodic explanations so long as the dispute continues is better.

While addressing first the requirement for clear communication, we should also be clear that we expect him to follow the rest of the dispute resolution policy. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 11:26, Apr 19, 2004 (UTC)

: Requiring clear communication and (more generally) following the dispute resolution process makes sense to me. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 21:59, 19 Apr 2004 (UTC)

Wik's call for help on Recent Changes [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Wikipedia:Recentchanges&diff=3462742&oldid=3462694] is interesting. It give insight into his feelings of helplessness when dealing with other aggressive users such as Cantus. Rather than putting that notice on Recent Changes what should he have done? One rather obvious thing as he and Cantus are both involved in this case would be to have requested relief here. We have asked him specifically, "Question to Wik: Are there any counter-complaints you wish to make in relation to this case? If so, please add to Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wik2". Actually he has done so, but we have not addressed the relief he requested regarding Cantus, banning for violations of the three revert rule. He give the example of [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Schnorrer&action=history] [[Schnorrer]], but we don't know what edit war prompted the plea on Recent Changes. Although looking at [[User:Cantus]] I find Cantus's revert list. I have looked at these in the past. These are the same sort of sterile, six of one, half a dozen of the other, disputes that Wik is prone to engage in. What I suggest is that we ban Cantus and Wik from editing any of the articles on Cantus's hit list:

<big>'''Articles needing frequent monitoring'''</big>

* '''[[Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] removing [[Mongolia]] and other additions.
* '''[[East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] and [[User:172|172]] adding Mongolia.
* '''[[Template:Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] and [[User:172|172]] removing Mongolia and [[People's Republic of China|China]].
* '''[[Template:East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] adding Mongolia.
* '''[[Template:Europe]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Europe&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] removing [[Azerbaijan]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] and [[Kazakhstan]].
* '''[[Mongolia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Mongolia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] replacing references to [[Central Asia]] with [[East Asia]] references.
* '''[[Schnorrer]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Schnorrer&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] removing [[Karl Schnörrer]] disambiguation link.

----

<big>'''To be reverted upon unprotection'''</big>

* '''[[Mongolia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Mongolia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:Europe]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Europe&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:Jiang|Jiang]].


Wik's complaint against Uncle Ed. See post by Jimbo [http://mail.wikipedia.org/pipermail/wikien-l/2004-February/010773.html] and Ed's response in that thread  [http://mail.wikipedia.org/pipermail/wikien-l/2004-February/010725.html] Seems rather mild. I don't think any action is required. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 14:19, May 14, 2004 (UTC)

===Proposed principles===
''Principles have been agreed upon and moved to [[/Decided]]''

===Proposed findings of fact===

''Some findings of fact have agreed upon and moved to [[/Decided]]''

====Personal attacks====
* Wik on his user page characterizes a wide variety of other users as "morons", vandals", "trolls", "Nazi POV pushers", "Zionist POV pushers" "vigilantes" and as members of a "Cabal". Some users he characterizes  as "rude" or "lier", others he accuses of  "deception" and "trickery". See [[User:Wik]]. We find that this is a violation of our [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks|No personal attacks]] policy.
:Support:
:#[[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 13:00, May 5, 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 19:33, 2004 May 5 (UTC)
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:Oppose:
:#[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 14:03, 5 May 2004 (UTC)
:Other:
:#Abstain. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 19:03, 5 May 2004 (UTC) (as noted below)
:#I agree with the sentiment, but those things aren't actually on his page any more. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 03:02, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC) I, too, abstain; to much 'micromanagement' indeed.

Well, true, but it would be completely asymmetric to single out Wik for criticism here: I've seen Jor (on this page) call Wik a "troll", and similar comments have been made by others. I think getting into this kind of thing is just micro-management, at this stage - if Wikipedians generally start being more polite and respectful of each other, it would be a different case, but this doesn't seem wildly outside common practice to me. Were it not for the other issues, I doubt the rudeness here would have got as far as us. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 23:50, 26 Apr 2004 (UTC)
:Wik's personal attacks are vicious and malicious, and not just momentary lapses in judgment. We should take a stand against them. [[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 19:33, 2004 May 5 (UTC)

Seeing as Wik has now deleted those comments from his user page this might seem an academic point, but I don't think it's right to vote against this finding. Those comments are clearly personal attacks. If, for whatever reason, you don't think they should be considered, then I'd ask you to abstain rather than vote against - by opposing this you are, it seems to me, saying that calling somebody a moron does not break [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks]]. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]]

: That's a fair point - I've changed my vote to abstain. ''Some of'' Wik's comments are clearly against guidelines. Some are fairly reasonable - surely if you find someone rude, it's reasonable to say so, if you don't shout or flood or harass? But the main reason I object to the current finding is its assymmetry, so abstention is more accurate than opposition. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 23:35, 6 May 2004 (UTC)

::Yes, I wouldn't berate somebody for calling a user "rude", but calling them a "moron", and doing it not in the heat of the moment but on your user page, and then refusing to take it back, is probably a few steps up from that. Still, that stuff isn't on [[User:Wik]] any longer (I thank Wik for removing it, incidentally), so I'm not going to bang on about this. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]]



===Remedies===

''Some remedies have been agreed upon and moved to [[/Decided]]''

*Wik is required to remove his hit list of personal attacks from his user pages and to desist from making personal attacks of a similar nature. 
:Support:
:#[[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 13:00, May 5, 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 15:58, 2004 May 5 (UTC) user page to be blanked during ban, containing only notice that user is banned. Suggest adding "for these personal attacks, Wik shall be banned from editing for a period of one week, to be served concurrently with other bans. Reverting to previous state after the ban is over will result in another one-week editing ban."
:#* Folks can edit any page, and we don't need to rule on what Wik's user page will look like while he's gone. Also, I suggest using the same enforcement as proposed below (under enforcement). [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:58, 5 May 2004 (UTC)
:#** I think we should rule that the personal attacks shall be removed from Wik's user page and having the fact that Wik is banned clearly displayed on his user page will strenghten our appearance as a truly power-wielding group rather than a bunch of apologists for bad behavior, which I fear is the reputation we are earning. [[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 19:33, 2004 May 5 (UTC)
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (personal attacks should be removed) 
:Oppose:
:#[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 14:02, 5 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:33, 5 May 2004 (UTC) (If we banned everyone who called another user a "troll" or a "vandal", in the current climate, we'd have nobody left. These are a minor issue, and by criticising Wik on this basis we would trivialise the seriousness of Wik's abuse of the revert facility)
:#*I have to disagree. I think Wik's personal attacks on his user page are the most blatant and damaging violations of policy he has made. In fact, Jimbo has implied now, in posts both the mailing lists, that his behavior on his user page should be grounds for banning, and I agree. We need to take a stand now against personal attacks, starting with the most blatant and unrepentant. We should not tolerate malicious personal attacks become some people occasionally get a little hot under the collar and call each other names. Besides, he's not just calling people "trolls" and "vandals"; he's calling people morons and nazis. I don't think we should be apologists for that. [[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 19:19, 2004 May 5 (UTC)
:Other:
:#I agree with the sentiment expressed by nohat, but Wik has now removed those things from his user page, so this seems irrelevant. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 03:02, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Delirium|Delirium]] 11:19, May 7, 2004 (UTC) Abstain, since the issue is now moot.
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC) Agree with Camembert/Delirium.

==== Enforcement ====

* If Wik consistently fails to abide by any of these rulings of the arbitration committee or tries to evade them, that Wik shall be banned for 30 days, at arbitration committee's discretion.
:Support:
:#[[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 13:00, May 5, 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 14:02, 5 May 2004 (UTC) I'd prefer three months, below. 
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 15:58, 2004 May 5 (UTC) after 3 month ban
:#[[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:33, 5 May 2004 (UTC) (I'd prefer one of the below two alternatives)
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Delirium|Delirium]] 11:19, May 7, 2004 (UTC) I'm wiling to go along with this, but this seems more like just a warning than an actual ruling, since we'd have to rule again on the 30-day ban anyway.  Is this actually saying anything?
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 22:44, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (though I'd prefer one of the below two alternatives)
:Oppose:
:Other:

:''Note that I've moved the above to [[/Decided]] as it has a majority, but I'm leaving it here as the below proposals modify it. Presumably, if one of the below gets a majority in favour, it will supersede this one, yes? --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 19:12, 20 May 2004 (UTC) ''

:: Makes sense to me. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 23:06, 20 May 2004 (UTC)

I'd actually prefer the below (which might as well be a general principle). [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]]

* If Wik consistently fails to abide by, or tries to evade, any of the rulings made against him by the arbitration committee, the committee may apply an immediate ban of between one month and one year. Such bans will be at the discretion of the arbitration committee, following a motion on this page supported by four or more arbitrators.

:Support:
:#[[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:33, 5 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 19:33, 2004 May 5 (UTC)
:#[[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 19:38, May 5, 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 03:02, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:Oppose:
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (one year is way too long at this point - I consider this Wik's second, not third strike)
:#[[User:Delirium|Delirium]] 11:19, May 7, 2004 (UTC) I don't like the only-4-vote requirement, or the year possibility.
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC) Too easy to implement such a long ban.
:Other:

Ok, let's try again then. The initial warning is just a bit vague - what does "discretion" mean, exactly? [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]]

* If Wik consistently fails to abide by, or tries to evade, any of the rulings made against him by the arbitration committee, the committee may apply an immediate ban of up to one month. Such bans will be at the discretion of the arbitration committee, following a simple majority vote of the committee.
:Support:
:#[[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 20:34, 7 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 22:44, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (up to a year would still be fine with me (especially with the change from four votes -> majority))
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 22:32, 17 May 2004 (UTC) (this is better)
:Oppose:
:Other:

====Permanent ban====
As Wik has both threatened and apparently carried through with a vandalism script which affects Wikipedia he is banned for an indefinite period. Any edits he makes should be reverted. Any new articles, deleted.

:Support:
:# [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 02:11, Jun 16, 2004 (UTC)

:Oppose:
:#

:Abstain or other:
:# Not necessary - vandalism can already be terminated with extreme prejudice. If Wik starts trying to make bona fide edits then we can discuss. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:30, 16 Jun 2004 (UTC)
:# What Martin said. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 19:33, 16 Jun 2004 (UTC)
:# Agreed. [[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 00:42, 17 Jun 2004 (UTC)
:#''Whoever'' is running the script is already under an indefinite if not permanent ban. Since it is plainly obvious that this is Wik, he has already chosen his own fate and has already been blocked for an indefinite time period by Tim (02:00, 17 Jun 2004, Tim Starling blocked Wik (expires indefinite) (contribs) (unblock) (vandalism) ; see block log). This is beyond the scope of the AC. If/when Wik wants to come back as a legit user then we could then vote to lift the ''already imposed'' indefinite ban. Any admin can already block vandals - they don't need our permission. --[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 23:58, 17 Jun 2004 (UTC)
# We don't need to rule before the Wikipedia can exercise its right to self-defense. --[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 11:53, 19 Jun 2004 (UTC)

==== Revocation of editing privileges ====

''If any of the following options are supported, then the one with more votes will go into effect''

*One month ban: Considering Wik's disruptive behavior as a whole and his disruptive effect on Wikipedia he is banned from editing for 1 month. 
:Support:
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 22:03, 2004 May 5 (UTC)
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC) Though perhaps verging on a little too long.
:Oppose:
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (too long at this point - I still have hope that Wik can be reformed. Save the longer bans for Wik3.)
:#[[User:Delirium|Delirium]] 11:19, May 7, 2004 (UTC) Too long.
:#[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 22:15, 9 May 2004 (UTC) (I've become convinced that the above requirement to explain reversions backed up with the prospect of a ban is sufficient. I ''hope'' a ban won't be necessary)
:Other:

*Three month ban: Considering Wik's disruptive behavior as a whole and his disruptive effect on Wikipedia he is banned from editing for 3 months. 
:Support:
:#[[User:The Epopt|the Epopt]] 14:02, 5 May 2004 (UTC)
:#[[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 15:58, 2004 May 5 (UTC). Suggest adding "creation of sock puppet users will result in extension of ban by one month for each sock puppet"
:#[[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 16:37, May 5, 2004 (UTC)
:Oppose:
:#[[User:Maveric149|mav]] 08:01, 7 May 2004 (UTC) (too long - see above)
:# [[User:Delirium|Delirium]] 11:19, May 7, 2004 (UTC) Quite a bit too long.
:#[[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 12:26, 7 May 2004 (UTC) Far too long - we want Wik to stay and reform, not leave.
:#[[User:Camembert|Camembert]] 22:15, 9 May 2004 (UTC) (see above)
:Other:
:# [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 18:45, 5 May 2004 (UTC) - I think this is a little too long. I believe the ''Enforcement'' noted above where we provide ourselves the facility to note a further ban at our discretion, means that an initial ban of this length is not required.

====Sterile disputes====
Both Wik and Cantus are prohibited from editing certain pages where they (and a few others) have engaged in sterile revert wars where little or no significant information is at issue. While this list may be expanded it includes the following articles (taken from [[User:Cantus]]):

<big>'''Articles needing frequent monitoring'''</big>

* '''[[Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] removing [[Mongolia]] and other additions.
* '''[[East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] and [[User:172|172]] adding Mongolia.
* '''[[Template:Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] and [[User:172|172]] removing Mongolia and [[People's Republic of China|China]].
* '''[[Template:East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] adding Mongolia.
* '''[[Template:Europe]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Europe&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] removing [[Azerbaijan]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] and [[Kazakhstan]].
* '''[[Mongolia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Mongolia&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]], [[User:172|172]] and [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]] replacing references to [[Central Asia]] with [[East Asia]] references.
* '''[[Schnorrer]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Schnorrer&action=history H]</sup> — [[User:Wik|Wik]] removing [[Karl Schnörrer]] disambiguation link.

----

<big>'''To be reverted upon unprotection'''</big>

* '''[[Mongolia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=Mongolia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:Central Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Central_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:Europe]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:Europe&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:John Kenney|John Kenney]].
* '''[[Template:East Asia]]'''<sup>[http://en.wikipedia.org/w/wiki.phtml?title=MediaWiki:East_Asia&action=history H]</sup> — Protected by [[User:Jiang|Jiang]].

# Support [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 14:25, May 14, 2004 (UTC)

====Users Wik refuses to discuss articles with====
Based on Wik's statement, "I already said I'm not dealing with Cantus, neither directly nor by proxy.", see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk%3AWik#Central_Asia] Wik is banned from editing any article he is engaged in a edit war with Cantus (or any other user he decides he will not discuss matters with) for a period of one year.

Isn't this just a logical consequence of the ruling above to explain his reverts? Better to edit that ruling, if it is not clear, surely? [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 11:01, 15 May 2004 (UTC)
:Explaining reverts is one thing. Refusing to communicate with those he habitually disputes with is another. But feel free to make a stab at it and try crafting a remedy. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 14:10, May 15, 2004 (UTC)

=== Closure === 

I move that this case be closed. [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 00:17, 13 Jun 2004 (UTC)

Needed? Who knows... If I don't get any vetos, I'll consider it closed and edit appropriately. Bolder than thou. :) - [[User:MyRedDice|Martin]] 00:53, 13 Jun 2004 (UTC)

Well, for what it's worth, I'm happy for it to be closed. --[[User:Camembert|Camembert]]

We still have to consider the matter of the vandal bot. [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 14:56, Jun 16, 2004 (UTC)

: [[User:Jdforrester|James F.]] [[User_talk:Jdforrester|(talk)]] 15:06, 16 Jun 2004 (UTC)

No edits should be made to this page except by clerks or arbitrators.''' *Any violations of the remedies passed in the case should be raised at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Enforcement]]. *Specific requests for amendment or clarification about the decision should be raised at [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Clarification and Amendment]]. *General questions can be raised at [[Wikipedia talk:Arbitration Committee]]. *Actions taken to enforce remedies authorised in the case (if applicable) are to be logged at the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration enforcement log|centralised arbitration enforcement log]].}} == Case information == === Involved parties === *{{Userlinks|Hurricane Noah}} *{{Userlinks|MarioProtIV}} *{{Userlinks|LightandDark2000}} *{{Userlinks|United States Man}} *{{Userlinks|Chlod}} *{{Userlinks|Elijahandskip}} *{{Userlinks|HurricaneCovid}} ===Prior dispute resolution=== * [[Wikipedia:Administrators'_noticeboard/Incidents#Closure_mess_involving_off-wiki_discussion|ANI post]] ([[Special:Permalink/1079472088#Closure mess involving off-wiki discussion|permalink]]) by {{u|Compassionate727}} == Preliminary statements == ''Preliminary statements given in the case request stage may be found at [[/Preliminary statements]].'' ==Preliminary decision== === Clerk notes === * {{u|LightandDark2000}} - your statement and its edit summary contain veiled aspersions at the filer of this case and other participants. Such behaviour is not acceptable at Arbitration - I would remind you to keep your statements related directly to the matter at hand, and avoid unproductive or personalised comments. Your pre-emptive request for a word limit extension is declined given that by your own admission you are unlikely to actively participate further in the case request. [[User:Firefly|firefly]] ( [[User talk:Firefly|t]] · [[Special:Contributions/Firefly|c]] ) 10:08, 28 March 2022 (UTC) * {{u|Chess}}, I consider my involvement in the WPTC Discord to be minimal (most of it involves WPTC members who have decided that I should be pinged for every sockpuppet problem they come across, though I concede that I fussed at the members of the Discord for their the other day prior to this case request being filed). I am certainly not an "active participant". I do not believe that my involvement to date impacts my ability to remain neutral, though if the arbs feel differently I will recuse. [[User:GeneralNotability|GeneralNotability]] ([[User talk:GeneralNotability|talk]]) 01:27, 29 March 2022 (UTC) ===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (10/0/0)=== *I'm tentatively inclined to accept. The private evidence combined with the note from TheresNoTime that multiple warnings were given and it seems no one is listening are a good basis to open a case. Best, '''[[User:L235|KevinL]]''' (aka [[User:L235|L235]] '''·''' [[User talk:L235#top|t]] '''·''' [[Special:Contribs/L235|c]]) 06:17, 27 March 2022 (UTC) **'''Accept'''. '''[[User:L235|KevinL]]''' (aka [[User:L235|L235]] '''·''' [[User talk:L235#top|t]] '''·''' [[Special:Contribs/L235|c]]) 23:47, 28 March 2022 (UTC) **:{{re|Chess}} We don't have an established formal path for asking for a clerk to recuse, but if you really want to submit such a request, you may do so via {{clerks-l}}. Anyone wishing for an ''arbitrator'' (not a clerk) to recuse should follow the procedure at {{slink|Wikipedia:Arbitration/Policy#Recusal_of_arbitrators}}. Best, '''[[User:L235|KevinL]]''' (aka [[User:L235|L235]] '''·''' [[User talk:L235#top|t]] '''·''' [[Special:Contribs/L235|c]]) 02:49, 29 March 2022 (UTC) *I agree with Kevin. [[User:Primefac|Primefac]] ([[User talk:Primefac|talk]]) 06:43, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *:Cabayi, the opening statement by Compassionate727 at the linked ANI thread pretty clearly states that a closed discussion was re-opened and then re-closed with a different outcome because editors on Discord decided amongst themselves that the discussion should not be closed in the original manner. See specifically [[Special:Diff/1078681645]]. [[User:Primefac|Primefac]] ([[User talk:Primefac|talk]]) 09:43, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *::'''Accept''' per my previous. [[User:Primefac|Primefac]] ([[User talk:Primefac|talk]]) 11:38, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *I have been aware of this for quite some time, I logged on to the discord server to give a canvassing warning some months ago, which remained as a pinned post. I agree a case may be required, but equally, I am concerned about the scope. The server is out of our jurisdiction, for example, though we can accept private evidence regarding it [[User:Worm That Turned|''Worm'']]TT([[User talk:Worm That Turned|talk]]) 07:38, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *:'''Accept'''. Noting (in response to [[User:Serial Number 54129|Serial Number 54129]]) also that I do not believe that anyone needs to recuse over this case. We have a number of arbitrators who use discord on a different server. I do not believe any arbitrators have been involved in any of the discussions in question, except in a purely administrative capacity to warn the individuals in question. [[User:Worm That Turned|''Worm'']]TT([[User talk:Worm That Turned|talk]]) 18:56, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *::@[[User:Chess|Chess]], I strongly disagree that I have been involved in a conversational, non administrative role. It's easy to see all 4 posts I have made to the server, which I would rather not clutter this page with - but I will summarise. 1) "Hello" 2) A warning in July 2021 about canvassing - this was about 4 paragraphs long and has remained as a pinned post on the server since 3) In response to the ANI thread on 26 March (above) where I was pinged, I accessed the server for the first time since July and I made 2 posts within 2 minutes - each was based on a quick read of the situation at that time. First expressing my disappointment and deferring to TNT, who I believed was handling the situation. 4) Secondly in response to Hurricane Noah's request for a block specifically stating (on discord) that they were "falling on their sword". I pointed out that we fix forward on Wikipedia and quitting was not a noble act. *::That is the sum total of my comments from my perspective, each made in a purely administrator capacity. [[User:Worm That Turned|''Worm'']]TT([[User talk:Worm That Turned|talk]]) 08:25, 28 March 2022 (UTC) *:::@[[User:Joe Roe|Joe Roe]], it appears we're fast on the way to opening the case, but I disagree that it should have the wider scope regarding Discord. Indeed, any such discussions regarding Discord as an off-wiki venue should be held by the community as part of wider discussions. It would only fall to Arbcom if the community were unable to handle such discussions, and I don't believe that's the case. I'd be swayed by evidence showing that any on-wiki discussions had been materially tainted by collusion exclusionary collaboration off-wiki. [[User:Cabayi|Cabayi]] ([[User talk:Cabayi|talk]]) 09:35, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *:Thanks {{u|Primefac}}. ∃>1 instance, ∴pattern of behaviour, '''Accept''' [[User:Cabayi|Cabayi]] ([[User talk:Cabayi|talk]]) 10:57, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *'''Aceept''' per Kevin and Prime. - [[User talk:Donald Albury|Donald Albury]] 15:15, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *'''Accept''' --[[User:BDD|BDD]] ([[User talk:BDD|talk]]) 15:21, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *'''Accept''' given the previous warnings about canvassing suggesting an ongoing issue that needs examining and can only be done by ArbCom because of the offwiki evidence involved. {{u|TheresNoTime}} can I ask why you only blocked one of the two people coming out of that ANI? [[User:Barkeep49|Barkeep49]] ([[User_talk:Barkeep49|talk]]) 15:43, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *:{{re|Moneytrees}} you are correct we're talking behind the scenes. I expect we will use what we did during the [[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/Skepticism_and_coordinated_editing/Evidence#Summary_of_private_evidence_received_by_ArbCom|GSoW case]] which had a fair amount of private evidence as a starting point and make adjustments from there. [[User:Barkeep49|Barkeep49]] ([[User_talk:Barkeep49|talk]]) 03:14, 28 March 2022 (UTC) *:{{u|Joe Roe|Joe}} if we do our job right (which is obviously no guarantee) I think the final decision in this case which will be useful to editors who frequent other Wikipedia related Discord servers in how to avoid certain issues. I get that you think the consensus is there because of an ArbCom decision of long ago and that a new decision now could shift that consensus, but I don't see this committee overriding a community consensus in that way. I have some more thoughts I'll share at your user talk as well. [[User:Beeblebrox|Beeblebrox]] ([[User talk:Beeblebrox|talk]]) 17:56, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *'''Accept''' per above. — [[User:Wugapodes|Wug·]][[User talk:Wugapodes|a·po·des]]​ 20:44, 27 March 2022 (UTC) *'''Accept''' I just got back from a wikibreak for RL business, but having read this over now, I agree with the above as well. [[User:Opabinia regalis|Opabinia regalis]] ([[User talk:Opabinia regalis|talk]]) 07:00, 29 March 2022 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision= ''All tallies are based the votes at [[/Proposed decision]], where comments and discussion from the voting phase is also available.'' ==Principles== ===Jurisdiction=== 1) The Arbitration Committee has jurisdiction only over the behavior of editors on the English Wikipedia. While the Arbitration Committee may take note of off-wiki behavior for the purposes of settling on-wiki disputes and in its remedies, restricting the off-wiki behavior of users is not within its remit. :''Passed 12 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Off-wiki communication=== 2) While discussion of Wikipedia and editing in channels outside of Wikipedia itself (such as IRC, mailing lists, or web forums) is unavoidable and generally appropriate, using external channels for coordination of activities that, on-wiki, would be inappropriate is also improper. That such conversations can be, or are, done in secret makes it more difficult to detect but does not reduce the impropriety of holding them. :''Passed 12 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Presumption of coordination=== 4) When a group of editors consistently and repeatedly participate in the same discussions to support the same point of view — especially when many or most of the members of that group had little or no prior participation in the underlying dispute — it is reasonable to presume that they could be coordinating their actions. Evaluation of consensus in particularly divisive or controversial cases need to carefully weigh the possibility and avoid ascribing too much weight to the number of participants in a discussion — especially when policy enforcement or sanctions are considered. :''Passed 12 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Consensus=== 5) Wikipedia relies on [[Wikipedia:consensus|consensus]] as its fundamental editorial process. Consensus develops from agreement of the parties involved. To ensure transparency, consensus cannot be formed except on Wikipedia discussion pages. "Off-wiki" discussions, such as those taking place on other websites, on web forums or on IRC, are not taken into account when determining consensus. :''Passed 12 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Building consensus: WikiProjects=== 6) [[Wikipedia:WikiProject|WikiProjects]] have no special status in developing consensus on matters of content, policy or procedures. Any Wikipedia editor may participate in developing a consensus on any matter that interests them. :''Passed 10 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ==Findings of fact== ===WPTC Discord server=== 1) WikiProject Tropical cyclones Discord server encourages compliance with the wider Wikipedia community's expectations. It is advertised on-wiki at [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Tropical cyclones]] and [[Wikipedia:Discord#Other servers]], along with an invitation link. There are no pre-conditions to join. Users on the server are asked to authenticate their accounts to their Wikpedia accounts using [[:m:Discord#WikiAuthBot|WikiAuthBot]]. The server's rules are pinned in a #rules channel dated 28 May 2021. Notably, the rules mirror [[WP:Harassment]], [[WP:CANVASS]], & [[WP:OUTING]]. :1. Be nice and respectful to each other. No slurs or hateful language, personal attacks, harassment of other members will be tolerated. :5. Canvassing of discussions (WP:AFD, WP:GAN, WP:RFA, WP:RFC, etc.) is prohibited. Links to discussions can be removed without warning. :6. Be mindful of your own privacy and the privacy of other members. This server is not private, anyone can access it. Do not post personal information (phone, address, name, etc.) The Discord server also supports the [https://hurricanes.fandom.com/ Hurricanes Fandom wiki] which may lead to divergent objectives among its users. :''Passed 10 to 0 with 1 abstentions at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===WPTC Discord server warnings=== 2) Three uninvolved administrators joined the server in 2021 and 2022 to warn its members against improper off-wiki coordination. One such warning, by Worm That Turned, was pinned as a reminder to its members about appropriate expectations. (preliminary statements, private evidence) :''Passed 11 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Behavior at merge discussion=== 3.1) Hurricane Noah proposed a merge on an article, prompting 5 other individuals to comment over a 6 month period. The discussion was closed with consensus to merge by [[User:Compassionate727|Compassionate727]] who had [[Special:Diff/1078527127|not participated]]. Very soon after, MarioProtIV [[Special:Diff/1078528592|reopened the discussion]], followed by Hurricane Noah [[Special:Diff/1078529713|re-closing it as withdrawn with no consensus]] despite both having been involved participants. During the merge discussion, Hurricane Noah and another participant [[User:Destroyeraa|Destroyeraa]] noted their off-wiki discussions, though MarioProtIV did not. :''Passed 11 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Edit warring by proxy=== 4.1) MarioProtIV, Elijahandskip, and Chlod have on multiple separate occasions used the WPTC discord server to ask for other editors to intervene in content disputes where they had already performed three reverts and did not want to be blocked. (private evidence) :''Passed 9 to 1 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===LightandDark2000 targeting of editors=== 5) LightandDark2000 used Discord to target Chicdat and United States Man, including attempts to get server participants to participate in conduct discussions against them and to revert their edits. He was warned against this by some server members, including Hurricane Noah, and members of the server expressed a range of opinions in the onwiki conduct discussions. (private evidence) :''Passed 11 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Elijahandskip=== 8) Elijahandskip over a two month period in early 2022 used the WPTC Discord server to bring attention to the actions of United States Man. This served to support the targeting of United States Man by LightandDark2000. (private evidence) :''Passed 8 to 1 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===Chlod=== 9) Chlod has served as a moderator of the WikiProject Tropical Cyclone Discord server since October 2021. Since that time, on multiple separate occasions {{they|Chlod}} used the WPTC Discord server to ask for other editors to intervene in content disputes, to avoid being blocked, after having already made three reverts. At other times, Chlod did remind server members of Wikipedia behavioral expectations, including cautioning against canvassing. :''Passed 8 to 1 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ''All remedies that refer to a period of time (for example, a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months) are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===MarioProtIV & NAC=== {{collapse top|1=Rescinded by [[#Motion: MarioProtIV's editing restriction rescinded (June 2025)|motion]] at 03:11, 28 June 2025 (UTC)}} 4) MarioProtIV is indefinitely banned from closing, or reopening, any discussion outside their own user talk space. This restriction may be appealed after 12 months. :''Passed 7 to 2 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ::''Rescinded by [[#Motion: MarioProtIV's editing restriction rescinded (June 2025)|motion]] at 03:11, 28 June 2025 (UTC)'' {{collapse bottom}} === Chlod warned=== 6a) Chlod is warned about using off-wiki platforms in an attempt to win on-wiki disputes. :''Passed 9 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' === Elijahandskip warned=== 7a) Elijahandskip is warned about using off-wiki platforms in an attempt to win on-wiki disputes. :''Passed 9 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===LightandDark2000 topic ban=== 8) LightandDark2000 is indefinitely [[WP:TBAN|topic banned]] from pages about weather, broadly construed. This ban may be appealed six months after the enactment of this remedy, and every twelve months thereafter. :''Passed 10 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ===MarioProtIV topic ban=== {{collapse top|1=Rescinded by [[#Motion:_WikiProject_Tropical_Cyclones_(September_2023)|motion]] at 10:35, 8 September 2023 (UTC)}} 9) MarioProtIV is indefinitely [[WP:TBAN|topic banned]] from pages about weather, broadly construed. This ban may be appealed six months after the enactment of this remedy, and every twelve months thereafter. :''Passed 9 to 0 at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ::''Rescinded by [[#Motion:_WikiProject_Tropical_Cyclones_(September_2023)|motion]] at 10:35, 8 September 2023 (UTC)'' {{collapse bottom}} ===Recommended practices for off-wiki chat platforms=== 10) Leaders/moderators of off-wiki chat platforms (i.e. IRC, Discord, Telegram) should consider the following practices for their platform: * Advertised on-wiki, including at relevant Wiki Project pages and more general pages (e.g. [[WP:DISCORD]]). * Instructions and links on how to join are provided. * Users are asked to authenticate to their onwiki identity. * The rules and expectations are posted in a prominent place (e.g. a read-only channel). [[WP:HARASSMENT]], [[WP:CANVASS]] & [[WP:OUTING]] are considered in those rules and expectations. * There is active moderation to enforce the rules and expectations. The moderation team is made up of trusted members and is sufficiently large for the size of the platform/channel. :''Passed 6 to 0 with 2 abstentions at 14:20, 27 May 2022 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== {{Arbitration standard provisions}} ==Amendments== ===Motion: WikiProject Tropical Cyclones (September 2023)=== {{ivmbox|1=[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/WikiProject_Tropical_Cyclones#MarioProtIV_topic_ban|Remedy 9]] of the ''[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/WikiProject_Tropical_Cyclones|WikiProject Tropical Cyclones]]'' case ("MarioProtIV topic ban") is rescinded.}} :''Passed 9 to 0 by [[Special:Permalink/1174425318#Motion:_WikiProject_Tropical_Cyclones|motion]] at 10:35, 8 September 2023 (UTC)'' ===Motion: MarioProtIV's editing restriction rescinded (June 2025)=== {{ivmbox|1=[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/WikiProject Tropical Cyclones#MarioProtIV & NAC|Remedy 4 (MarioProtIV & NAC)]] of ''[[Wikipedia:Arbitration/Requests/Case/WikiProject Tropical Cyclones|WikiProject Tropical Cyclones]]'' is rescinded.}} :''Passed 7 to 1 with 1 abstention by [[Special:Permalink/1297725529#Motion: MarioProtIV's editing restriction rescinded|motion]] at 03:11, 28 June 2025 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement log== {{Wikipedia:Arbitration Committee/Enforcement log section}} [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}

'''Case Opened''' on 00:50, 15 Feb 2005 (UTC) '''Case Closed''' on 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC) Please do not edit this page directly unless you wish to become a participant in this case; editing this page implicitly authorizes the other participants to enter a complaint against you which may be considered by the Arbitrators as may your behavior. Comments are very welcome on the [[Wikipedia talk:{{PAGENAME}}|Talk page]], and will be read, in full. Evidence, no matter who can provide it, is very welcome at [[/Evidence]]. Evidence is more useful than comments. Arbitrators will be working on a proposed decision at [[/Proposed decision]]. ==The parties== [[User:ChrisO|ChrisO]] and [[User:Violetriga|violet/riga]] [[User_talk:violetriga|(t)]] and [[User:WikiUser|WikiUser]] ==Statement of complaint == Since joining Wikipedia last June, [[User:WikiUser]] has consistently engaged in a pattern of personal attacks and other deliberately disruptive behavior, including repeated reversions of articles, refusal to abide by Wikipedia policies and Wikiquette, and making strongly POV edits. He consistently refuses to compromise and refuses to enter into civilized dialogue with other editors with whom he disagrees. He also constantly accuses others of making personal attacks, including that they are "Nazis", "racists", "stalkers" and "fascists" and are guilty of "discrimination" against him. He spends most of his time complaining about his supposed wrongful treatment or attacking editors in often crude personal terms. He has repeatedly made legal threats against users and the "Wikipedia Foundation" (sic) and has made several frivolous attempts to invoke mediation and arbitration procedures against users who have questioned his conduct. He has been temporarily banned on several occasions and his conduct criticised by many editors and administrators, including Jimbo Wales himself, but his conduct does not appear to have been improved in the process. He has also recently extended his activities to serial vandalism of articles on the Simple English Wikipedia, apparently in retaliation for edits by [[User:Netoholic]] with which he disagreed. A full description of events is at [[Wikipedia:Requests for comment/WikiUser]]; summary evidence is at [[/Evidence]]. ==Statement by affected party== ''Please limit your statement to 500 words'' Discussion by Arbitrators [edit] General [edit] Motion to close Four net Aye votes needed to close case (each Nay vote subtracts an Aye) 24 hours from the first motion is normally the fastest a case will close. David Gerard 14:51, 25 Feb 2005 (UTC) everything that should pass has; enforcement 2.3 could do with more, but has passed anyway ➥

the Epopt 15:05, 25 Feb 2005 (UTC)MISCREANT SHOULD RECUSE AS COMMITTED GRATUITOUS ABUSE AGAINST ME. THEY'RE BREAKING THEIR OWN, AND JIMMY'S RULES AS USUAL.-WIKIUSER Ambi 15:07, 25 Feb 2005 (UTC)

Fred Bauder 16:23, Feb 25, 2005 (UTC)MISCREANT SHOULD RECUSE AS COMMITTED GRATUITOUS ABUSE AGAINST ME. THEY'RE BREAKING THEIR OWN, AND JIMMY'S RULES AS USUAL. Theresa Knott [http://www.popehat.com/irrationally-infallible-though/2004/12/14/actual-mail-from-actual-viewers-speaking-of-tribadism.html (ask the rotten)] 16:36, 25 Feb 2005 (UTC) Retrieved from "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/WikiUser/Proposed_decision"

YOU PEOPLE CRAZEEEEE AS WELL AS THICK AND [http://www.247news.net/2004/20041211-wikipedia.shtml EVIL]. ==Preliminary decision== ===Arbitrators' opinions on hearing this matter (6/0/3/0)=== *Recuse; have had negative dealings with this user in the past. Strongly recommend acceptance of case. -- [[User:Grunt|Grun]][[User talk:Grunt|t]] [[European Union|🇪🇺]] 04:24, 2005 Feb 12 (UTC) *Recuse. [[User:David Gerard|David Gerard]] 17:47, 13 Feb 2005 (UTC) * Accept [[User:Theresa knott|Theresa Knott]] [[User talk:Theresa knott| (The snott rake)]] 10:21, 14 Feb 2005 (UTC) *Accept [[User:Nohat|Nohat]] 07:02, 19 Feb 2005 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision = ''All numbering based on [[/Proposed decision]]'' (vote counts and comments are there as well) ==Principles== ===No personal attacks=== 1) [[Wikipedia:No personal attacks|No personal attacks]]. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Courtesy=== 2) Wikipedia users are required to be courteous in their dealings with other users. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Vandalism=== 3) [[Wikipedia:Vandalism|Vandalism]] of Wikipedia will not be tolerated. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Edit warring / three-revert rule=== 4) Users are expected to avoid [[Wikipedia:Edit war|edit wars]] and to respect the [[Wikipedia:Three-revert rule|three-revert rule]]. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Legal threats=== 5) [[Wikipedia:No legal threats|No legal threats]]. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ====Editing Wikipedia during a legal dispute==== 5.5) It is best for both Wikipedia and its users that those who are in a legal dispute with it or its users discontinue editing until all legal disputes which they have initiated have been resolved. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Sockpuppetry=== 6) The ''use'' of [[Wikipedia:Sockpuppet|sockpuppet]] accounts, while not generally forbidden, is discouraged. ''Abuse'' of sockpuppet accounts, such as using them to evade blocks and bans, make personal attacks or reverts, or vandalize, is strictly forbidden. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Reasonableness and disruption=== 7.1) Wikipedia users are expected to behave reasonably with respect to editing and relating to other users. Editing practices that cause disruption to the normal functioning of Wikipedia will not be tolerated. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ==Findings of Fact== ===Editing from an anonymous ip=== 1) [[User:WikiUser]] has frequently edited from the ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210], see [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=5068576] and [http://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=next&oldid=22807] :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Personal attacks=== 2) Editing from the ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210] and as [[User:WikiUser]] WikiUser has made personal attacks: [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimmy_Wales&diff=prev&oldid=10194870], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=10194808&oldid=10194753], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=prev&oldid=10194808], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Jimbo_Wales&diff=next&oldid=10194828], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Welcome%2C_newcomers&diff=prev&oldid=10141691], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=prev&oldid=5043387 "nazi raul654"], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=5068576], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=5003350], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=5023215], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=prev&oldid=5001621], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=4226548], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=5043204&oldid=5043144] and [http://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=22793] :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Discourtesy=== 3. Editing from the ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210] and under [[User:WikiUser]] WikiUser has been discourteous in his dealings with other users: [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Evil_Monkey&diff=9681485&oldid=9672808], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=5003350] and [http://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=next&oldid=22807] :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Vandalism=== 4) Editing from the ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210] [[User:WikiUser]] vandalized [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers]] and pages on [http://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Simple_English_GFDL&diff=prev&oldid=22853 Simple English]. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Three revert rule=== 5) Alternating as [[User:Wikiuser]] and the anonymous ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210] WikiUser created the article [[Secondary modern school]] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=prev&oldid=9540312]. When another editor edited it he [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=next&oldid=9561654 reverted at 11:35, Jan 22, 2005], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=next&oldid=9646906 again at 12:07, Jan 25, 2005], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=next&oldid=9651106 again at 14:49, Jan 25, 2005], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=next&oldid=9651647 again at 15:12, Jan 25, 2005] and [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secondary_modern_school&diff=next&oldid=9652785 again at 15:54, Jan 25, 2005]. :''Passed 7 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Legal threats=== 6) Editing from the ip [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Contributions&target=217.204.65.210 217.204.65.210] on [[User talk:WikiUser]] [[User:WikiUser]] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=5068576 made legal threats]. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Unreasonableness=== 7) [[User:WikiUser]] has on a number of occasions taken an unreasonable attitude with respect both to editing and with respect to the actions of other users: [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=9673194], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=5068576], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=5003350], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_talk%3AUK_Wikipedians%27_notice_board&diff=9800003&oldid=9799944], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Evil_Monkey&diff=prev&oldid=9681485], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=prev&oldid=9673194], [http://mail.wikimedia.org/pipermail/wikien-l/2004-November/017245.html], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_United_Kingdom-related_topics&diff=prev&oldid=7393047], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=prev&oldid=5042974], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:England&diff=prev&oldid=4226548], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:Violetriga&diff=prev&oldid=9685168], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=prev&oldid=4373136], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration&diff=5043204&oldid=5043144], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requested_moves&diff=10105928&oldid=10105699], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requested_moves&oldid=10108002#William_Quinby_De_Funiak_.26rarr.3B_William_Q_De_Funiak], [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia:Requested_moves&diff=next&oldid=10108354] and [http://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=User_talk:WikiUser&diff=next&oldid=22807] :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ==Remedies== ===Ban for personal attacks=== 1) [[User:WikiUser]] is banned for one year for personal attacks. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Ban for legal threats=== 4) [[User:WikiUser]] is banned for making legal threats. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Ban for unreasonableness=== 5.1) For behaviour causing significant disruption to the normal functioning of Wikipedia, including repeated personal attacks, discourtesy, vandalism, edit warring, and other unreasonable behaviour. WikiUser is banned for one year. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ==Enforcement== ===Bans to run concurrently=== 1) All bans of definite duration shall run concurrently. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Enforcement of ban for legal threats === 2.3) After one year with no further legal threats and no action taken it will be assumed that all disputes have been resolved and the ban for legal threats will be lifted. Further legal threats will reset the ban, and the ban will remain in place during and after any formal action taken. If other bans are not active and the matter is resolved prior to the lifting of this ban, Wikiuser can apply to the committee for a change to these conditions. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' ===Probation on return=== 3) [[User:WikiUser|WikiUser]] will be on a 6 month probation if he returns after the ban period has expired. If he behaves disruptively or unreasonably during that time he may be blocked for a period of up to one week. :''Passed 8 to 0 at 16:26, 26 Feb 2005 (UTC)'' [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}

'''Case Opened''' on 00:22, 28 November 2005 (UTC) '''Case Closed''' on 20:28, 24 December 2005 (UTC) Please do not edit this page directly unless you wish to become a participant in this request. (All participants are subject to Arbitration Committee decisions, and the ArbCom will consider each participant's role in the dispute.) Comments are very welcome on the [[Wikipedia talk:{{PAGENAME}}|Talk page]], and will be read, in full. Evidence, no matter who can provide it, is very welcome at [[/Evidence]]. Evidence is more useful than comments. Arbitrators will be working on evidence and suggesting proposed decisions at [[/Workshop]] and voting on proposed decisions at [[/Proposed decision]]. ==Involved parties== I request a merge to the previous case on Onefortyone seeking an addendum stating that Wyss and Ted Wilkes lay off 141. [[User:Mindspillage|Mindspillage]] [[User talk:Mindspillage|(spill yours?)]] 05:05, 22 November 2005 (UTC) ===Temporary injunction (none)=== =Final decision= ==Principles== ===Popular culture=== 1) Wikipedia includes articles about popular culture. :Passed 8-0 ===Sources for popular culture=== 2) [[Wikipedia:Verifiability]] and [[Wikipedia:Reliable sources]] do not specifically address the reliability required with respect to popular culture such as celebrity gossip, but it is unrealistic to expect peer reviewed studies. Therefore, when a substantial body of material is available — ''e.g.'', that shown by a google search for 'bisexual "James Dean"' [http://www.google.com/search?as_q=bisexual&num=10&hl=en&btnG=Google+Search&as_epq=James+Dean&as_oq=&as_eq=&lr=&as_ft=i&as_filetype=&as_qdr=all&as_occt=any&as_dt=i&as_sitesearch=&as_rights=&safe=images] — the best material available is acceptable, especially when comments on its reliability are included. :Passed 7-0 ===Obsession=== 3) Users who are otherwise productive editors but who disrupt particular articles due to obsessive concentration of attention on them or insistence on unrealistic standards may be banned from those articles. :Passed 8-0 == Proposed findings of fact == ===Prior case=== 1) This matter arises from [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Onefortyone]] which concerned complaints by Ted Wilkes that Onefortyone had aggressively pushed a personal agenda on Wikipedia focused on assertions that several celebrities, notably Elvis Presley and James Dean, had engaged in homosexual behavior. :Passed 7-0 ===Outcome of prior case=== 2} Onefortyone's edits were examined and found to be deficient in several respects, [[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Onefortyone#Fndings_of_fact]]. However, sometimes he did cite sources which were sufficient to support addition of information to articles, [[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Onefortyone/Workshop#Sources_cited_by_Onefortyone]] and [[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Onefortyone/Workshop#Edits_by_Onefortyone]]. :Passed 7-0 ===Remedy in prior case=== 3) Due to Onefortyone making some good edits but also having serious problems with regard to adequate sourcing of information he was not banned from editing articles which relate to celebrities but placed on [[Wikipedia:Probation]], [[Wikipedia:Requests_for_arbitration/Onefortyone#Onefortyone_placed_on_Probation]] effective 3 November 2005. :Passed 7-0 ===Nature of Probation=== 4) [[Wikipedia:Probation]] provides that an [[Wikipedia:Administrators|administrator]] may ban a user from editing an article if the terms of the probation are broken. Onefortyone was placed on the following probation:
; Onefortyone placed on Probation : 1) Onefortyone is placed on [[Wikipedia:Probation]] with respect to the biographies of celebrities. He may be banned from any article or talk page relating to a celebrity which he disrupts by aggressively attempting to insert poorly sourced information or original research.
:Passed 7-0 ===Characteristics of probation=== 5) [[Wikipedia:Probation]] is a relatively new remedy which relies on [[Wikipedia:Administrators]] for enforcement. As Ted Wilkes and Wyss were not administrators, they could not enforce it themselves but were required to attract the attention of a Wikipedia administrator with enough interest and energy to look into this matter and consider the sources Onefortyone was using. Attracting the attention of an administrator would probably best be accomplished by posting a notice on [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard/Incidents]], however Ted Wilkes and Wyss were not specifically informed of this, nor was it suggested at [[Wikipedia:Probation]]. :Passed 7-0 ===Edit warring by Ted Wilkes and Wyss=== 6) Following the decision attempts to edit by Onefortyone and his mentor FCYTravis were thwarted by reversions and edit warring by Ted Wilkes and Wyss [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone/Workshop#James Dean]] and [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone/Workshop#Nick Adams]] :Passed 7-0 ===Warning to Ted Wilkes and Wyss and response=== 7) Onefortyone complained about the edit warring and Ted Wilkes and Wyss were warned [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone/Workshop#Complaints and warning]]. Ted Wilkes responded that he intended to continue with his behavior [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone/Workshop#Ted Wilkes' response]]. :Passed 7-0 ===Ted Wilkes and Wyss's view of the standard of editing=== 8) Ted Wilkes and Wyss have repeatedly insisted on an unrealistic standard with respect to negative information regarding celebrities that is current in popular culture, gossip and rumor [[Talk:James Dean#Removal of "Rumors" section]] [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Talk:James_Dean&diff=prev&oldid=28187286] and [[Talk:Nick Adams#Rumors, gossip or speculation contravene official Wikipedia policy]] :Passed 7-0 ==Proposed remedies== ''Note: All remedies that refer to a period of time, for example to a ban of X months or a revert parole of Y months, are to run concurrently unless otherwise stated.'' ===Ted Wilkes and Wyss banned from making homosexuality/bisexuality edits=== 1) Ted Wilkes and Wyss are banned from making any edit related to a person's alleged homosexuality or bisexuality. The clauses "any edit" and "related to homosexuality or bisexuality" shall be interpreted broadly; this remedy is intended, for example, to prohibit correcting the spelling of "gay". :Passed 7-0 ===Ted Wilkes placed on Probation=== 2) Ted Wilkes is placed indefinitely on [[Wikipedia:Probation]]. If in the opinion of any three administrators, for good cause, he is responsible for disrupting the functioning of Wikipedia, restrictions may be placed on his editing, up to and including a general ban of one year. Each restriction imposed shall be documented and explained in a section at the bottom of [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone]]. Should any period of one year pass without any such restriction being imposed, Ted Wilkes's probation shall automatically end. :Passed 6-0 ===Wyss placed on Probation=== 3) Wyss is placed indefinitely on [[Wikipedia:Probation]]. If in the opinion of any three administrators, for good cause, she is responsible for disrupting the functioning of Wikipedia, restrictions may be placed on her editing, up to and including a general ban of one year. Each restriction imposed shall be documented and explained in a section at the bottom of [[Wikipedia:Requests for arbitration/Wilkes, Wyss and Onefortyone]]. Should any period of one year pass without any such restriction being imposed, Wyss's probation shall automatically end. :Passed 6-0 ==Proposed enforcement== ===Enforcement by block=== 1) Should Ted Wilkes or Wyss edit any article from which they are banned they may be blocked for a short period, up to a week in the case of repeat offenses. After 5 blocks the maximum block shall increase to one year. :Passed 7-0 ===Sockpuppets=== According to checkuser Wyss has returned and edited as {{Vandal|The_Witch}} [[User:Fred Bauder|Fred Bauder]] 18:45, 17 January 2006 (UTC) [[Category:Wikipedia arbitration cases|{{SUBPAGENAME}}]] {{NOINDEX}}
